articleTitle: Video Object Forgery Detection Algorithm Based on VGG-11 Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In recent years, with the development of computer multimedia technology, video forgery has become more and more common. For the video object forgery can cover up some key evidence and it is hard to identify by the experts, the forgery detection technology for this class had always been a research hotspot. However, researchers mostly pay attention to traditional methods such as image processing and classifiers and rarely combine deep learning theory to the research. This paper proposes a video intra-frame forgery forensics algorithm based on the VGG-11 convolutional neural network, which can automatically detect video forgery frames. The algorithm first decompresses the video into a series of frames, calculates the motion residual map of each frame, and extracts the steganographic features. Then four different steganographic feature sample sets are used to construct as the training set and the test set to train and test model. The best-performing feature was selected by the comparison experiment. Finally, the forged frame was marked from the forgery video successfully. A series of experiments show that the proposed algorithm based on the VGG-11 convolutional neural network can automatically identify original or forgery frames in forgery video.

Author Keywords: Video object forgery, VGG-11, Motion residual, Intra frame forgery

articleTitle: Identification of Sunflower Leaf Diseases Based on Random Forest Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Using digital image processing and machine learning technology to realize the automatic recognition of plant leaf diseases is of great significance to the prevention and control of crop diseases. In this paper, powdery mildew, bacterial leaf spot, black spot and downy mildew of sunflower leaves were studied. The image samples were denoised by morphological weight adaptive image denoising method. K-means + + clustering algorithm and watershed algorithm are used to segment the image of sunflower leaf disease. 19 feature values of color feature and texture feature are extracted from the diseased areas, and a random forest algorithm is constructed to identify the diseased areas. The overall recognition rate can reach 95%.

Author Keywords: image segmentation, sunflower disease, pattern recognition, random forest

articleTitle: Lateral Control Using Parameter Self-Tuning LQR on Autonomous Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: The goal of lateral control in autonomous driving is to accomplish the vehicle steering. It is a complicated dynamic system with unknown disturbance. By considering vehicle occupants changing, wind resistance, and the nonlinear uncertainties of rolling friction, an LQR optimal controller for lateral control is proposed in this paper. In the controller, simultaneous perturbation random approximation algorithm is used to optimize the weight matrices Q and R. The two-degree-of-freedom lateral dynamics model of the vehicle is established to evaluate the designed controller. The simulation results show that the designed controller can effectively improve the vehicle performance on tracking planning trajectory and enhance the robustness on lateral control system.

Author Keywords: lateral control, LQR optimal controller, simultaneous perturbation random approximation algorithm

articleTitle: Efficient Implementation of the Data Link Layer at the Receiver of JESD204B
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: JESD204B is the latest industry standard for the interface between data converters and logic devices. A quad-byte parallel implementation of the data link layer in JESD204B receiver was proposed, a series of data processing, the synchronization control and peripheral auxiliary functions prescribed in JESD204B protocol were implemented. Use of a topological structure for parallel processing control information and data information accelerated the circuit speed and reduced the number of logic layers of synchronization control module; furthermore the theoretical circuit operating clock frequency was reduced from 1.25 GHz to 312.5 MHz which made it easier to be implemented in low-cost CMOS technology. A docking verification between the Verilog model and XLINX's official JESD204B 6.1v receiver IP core was performed, and the simulation results were consistent with the theoretical analysis results; in addition, the design was synthesized with SMIC 180nm CMOS technology at Design Compiler platform, and the synthesis results show that the design fully met the JESD204B protocol specification in operating frequency, cell area and power consumption.

Author Keywords: JESD204B, data link layer, implementation

articleTitle: Face Recognition via Convolutional Neural Networks and Siamese Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Deep convolutional neural networks is playing very important role to solve computer vision task in these decades. In this research has shown implementation state of art face recognition methods and compared them. Advantages and disadvantages of Convolutional and Siamese neural networks is explored for the face recognition task. The novel face recognition system accuracy is checked on the widely used Labelled Faces in the Wild (LFW) dataset. In the study has introduced concepts of triplet loss function. Experiment results can be useful for the developers who is going to create AI applications such as Security system, Self-learning, Visitor analysis system, Face recognition system, Face verification system and many more.

Author Keywords: face recognition, convolutional neural networks, Siamese neural networks, triplet loss

articleTitle: Lidar-Based Fast 3D Stockpile Modeling
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: A lidar-based 3D stockpile modeling system was designed and implemented, which allows the operator to quickly obtain a 3D stockpile model with detailed features by simply carrying a portable scanning device to circle around the target stockpile. The system uses a line scanning lidar to scan a stockpile with high-precision sensors to measure the position and attitude of itself in real time, and then integrates discrete scanning points to form a 3D point cloud of the stockpile. In data processing, the algorithm was optimized according to the measurement characteristics of the line scanning lidar and the structural characteristics of the stockpile. Noise reduction for the scanning points and ground points removal was performed concurrently in the measurement process. In addition, the point cloud was projected onto a 2D plane for a quick Delaunay triangulation, thus improving the speed of 3D stockpile modeling effectively. Field experiments showed that the system can complete 3D modeling of large stockpiles within a few minutes. The modeling time mainly depends on the walking speed of the operator who circles around the stockpile, and the waiting time for the 3D modeling after the measurement is generally less than 30s.

Author Keywords: 3D stockpile modeling, line scanning lidar, noise points reduction, ground points removal, Delaunay triangulation

articleTitle: Traffic Signal Control with Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: To decrease the impact of Partially Observable MDP on deep reinforcement learning performance of intersection signal control, A deep reinforcement learning is proposed in this paper with utilizing the real-time GPS data as well as learning the control of the traffic lights in single intersection. We integrate deep reinforcement learning network (DRQN) with recurrent neural network (RNN) and apply deep network, experience pool and greedy strategy in deep reinforcement learning strategy. It solves the problem of overestimation of target Q value and insufficient long-term experience learning in the standard reinforcement learning of traffic signal control. The comparison of performance was made between the proposed method and standard Deep Q-Network (DQN) on the partial observation of traffic situations. The experimental results show that both DQN and DRQN methods can adjust their traffic signal timing control strategies according to the specific traffic conditions as well as calculating a lower average delay time of vehicle than that of fixed-time control. Besides, the simulation effect of DRQN learning method is better than that of DQN learning method in different probe vehicle proportion environment.

Author Keywords: Deep Reinforcement Learning, Traffic signal control, Partially Observable MDP, Vehicle network

articleTitle: Credit Card Fraud Identification Based on Principal Component Analysis and Improved Adaboost Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: As the issuance of credit cards grows rapidly, its risk cannot be underestimated. Due to the high dimension and sparsity nature of credit cards fraud data, it is easy to occur overfitting, low robustness and poor generalization in data mining. Therefore, this paper proposes a risk control algorithm for integrated learning, which is based on combining smote and principal component analysis for data processing, by using a single-layer decision tree and the improved Adaboost algorithm, as well as applying the trained risk control system to individual data for fraud identification. After testing the data sample of a commercial bank, the simulation results show that the accuracy rate of the improved integrated machine learning method reaches 96.50% and F-Measure value is 97.3%. In addition, comparing with other detection methods, the result proved that the proposed method is superior to traditional risk control technology, which also effectively completed the fraud detection work.

Author Keywords: Principal Component Analysis, Adaboost Algorithm, Fraud Identification

articleTitle: The Improved Siamese Network in Face Recognition
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: This paper is an application of Siamese Network in face recognition; the learning process is minimizing the logistic regression loss function that drives the metric to be small for the same persons, and significant for different persons. In practice, we hope that the distinction between the same persons and different persons is as significant as possible. Nevertheless, the standard sigmoid function does not characterize this feature very well. This paper improves the standard sigmoid function for this defect. The hypothesis verified by experiments and has achieved a useful application in engineering. This paper introduces the complete experimental process, analyzes the experimental results, and provides a theoretical explanation for the results.

Author Keywords: Siamese Network, sigmoid function, Face Recognition

articleTitle: An Algorithm for Fabric Defect Detection Based on Adaptive Canny Operator
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the parameters of traditional Canny operator need to be set manually and the adaptability of the algorithm is poor, this paper proposes an improved Canny operator algorithm for weaving damage detection. Firstly, the detection principle of traditional Canny operator is analyzed; secondly, the image processing of knitted fabric is improved by iterative filtering and single-scale Retinex (Retina and Cortex abbreviation) non-linear image enhancement method; then, the high and low thresholds of Canny operator are adaptively set by the method of maximum inter-class variance; finally, the algorithm is obtained by field experiments and the accuracy rate is 0.97. Compared with the traditional Canny operator, it has better adaptability and detection accuracy. At the same time, it can describe the details of knitted fabric defects better.

Author Keywords: fabric defect detection, image processing, Canny operator, adaptive threshold

articleTitle: BlockFedML: Blockchained Federated Machine Learning Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: With the emphasis on security and privacy, Federated Machine Learning (FML) systems have become a research hotspot due to it can perform machine learning models without compromising security and privacy. However, there are two crucial challenges. One is a gradient information leak, and the other is vulnerable to integrity attacks. In this paper, we proposed a Blockchained Federated Machine Learning System, which called "BlockFedML." In BlockFedML, we develop Security Parameter Aggregation Mechanisms, Checkpoint based-Smart Contracts, Incentive Mechanisms, and Transfer Learning. Finally, we outlined the BlockFedML system and its applications and explained our future work.

Author Keywords: security and privacy, machine learning, federated learning, blockchain

articleTitle: A Novel Technique of Software Cost Estimation Using Flower Pollination Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Estimating Cost of Software (ECS) is a very essential aspect of a software development life cycle. Accurate estimations are needed in terms of person month and development time for software projects. Several project estimation techniques have been developed such as parametric and non-parametric. Estimation by parametric is one of the convenient methods in the field of software engineering. However, parametric approaches used in the development of software cost estimation is not able to handle the definite data in an explicit and accurate way. Different computational intelligence algorithms like machine learning, evolutionary algorithms, and swarm intelligence algorithms have been applied to optimize the parameters of various ECS model. But however, accurate cost estimation is still a big issue in ECS. In this work, a Flower Pollination Algorithm (FPA) is proposed to optimize the parameters of a Constructive Cost Model II (COCOMO-II) via using a standard Turkish industry dataset. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm gives a better estimation as compared to existing approaches such as the Bat algorithm and original COCOMO-II in terms of Manhattan distance (MD) and mean magnitude of relative errors (MMRE).

Author Keywords: Estimating Cost of Software (ECS), COCOMO-II, Computational Intelligence Algorithms, Turkish Industry software project

articleTitle: Research on Massive Data Analysis of Power Utilization Based on Improved K-Means Algorithm and Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: For such difficulties as low mining efficiency and large amount of data that the data mining of residential electricity data has to be faced with, the research on improved K-means algorithm and cloud computing-based analysis on massive data of power utilization is performed. Firstly, as the initial cluster center and the value K is difficult to determine in traditional K-means algorithm, an improved K-means algorithm based on density is proposed. Defining the product of sample density, the reciprocal of the average distance between the samples in the cluster, and the distance between the clusters as weight product, the initial center is determined successively according to the maximum weight product method and the accuracy of the clustering is improved. Then, the parallelization of improved K-means algorithm based on MapReduce model is realized and the efficiency of clustering is improved. Finally, the mining experiment of massive power utilization data is carried out on basis of 400 households' electricity data. Taking family as unit, calculate such features as electricity consumption rate during peak hour, load rate, valley load coefficient and the percentage of power using during normal hour, and establish the data vector dimension, completing the clustering of similar user types, while analyzing the behavioral characteristics of each types of users. Experiment results on Hadoop cluster show that the improved algorithm can be stable and efficient operated and it can achieve better clustering effect.

Author Keywords: Power Utilization Data, Cloud Computing, Improved K-means Algorithm, MapReduce Model, Parallelization

articleTitle: Pedestrian Detection Using Optimized YOLOv3 in UAV Scenario
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Pedestrian detection is of great importance in computer vision task. It is a hard work since the performance is affected by environmental factors such as illumination, occlusion, and background clutters, especially in UAV scenario where the pedestrian is always with a small scale. In this paper, we propose adaptive random multi-scale variation method to detect small object in UAV scenario. First, the special pedestrian dataset used for UAV is collected to train the proposed method. Then, we improve YOLOv3, which is a classical one-stage object detection method, by data sample classification (normal, far, game scenario), adaptive random multi-scale variation, and k-means clustering to make the model robust to scale variation. Compared with the original YOLOv3 pedestrian detection result, the proposed model has a high detection precision (90.91%) and accuracy (80.59%).

Author Keywords: pedestrian detection, adaptive random multi-scale variation, UAV scenario.

articleTitle: Path Planning for Multi-Rotors UAVs Formation Based on Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Multiple unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) formation has a broad application prospects, which will be used widely in the civilian and military fields. An improved ant colony algorithm method is proposed to solve the problem of path planning in formation transformation. Firstly, we designed a location assignment based on ant colony optimization algorithm. Then a new node selection strategy is proposed to improve the optimization results. At the end, the simulation results show the effectiveness and progress of the method. The improved method proposed in this paper can avoid the results into the local optimization and the algorithm optimization speed has increased.

Author Keywords: unmanned aerial vehicles, path planning algorithm, Ant Colony Optimization Algorithm

articleTitle: A New Method for Fault Diagnosis of Building Electrical System Based on RBF-BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In order to improve the stability of building electrical system, an optimal method for fault diagnosis of electrical systems is needed. With the aim to improve the detection accuracy of traditional principal component fault analysis method and fault location accuracy, an optimized method for fault diagnosis of building electrical system based on RBF-BP neural network is proposed. The fault sensing information fusion method is used to capture the fault information on building electrical system, and a fuzzy c-means clustering algorithm is used to perform the clustering of fault information, which improves the classification ability of fault state attributes. The clustered fault data are used for RBF-BP neural network training, namely, RBF-BP is trained to make a proper classification decision. Using RBF-BP, the attributive classification of building electrical system fault is realized and fault diagnosis is achieved. The simulation results show that proposed method for building electrical system has higher accuracy in fault diagnosis, lower response latency and more robust performance than traditional principal component fault analysis method.

Author Keywords: building electrical system, fault diagnosis, RBF-BP neural network

articleTitle: An Improved LMS Adaptive Filtering Algorithm and Its Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: The advantage of the traditional fixed-step LMS algorithm is that it is simple and easy to implement, but its inherent disadvantage is that it increases the step factor to speed up the convergence and also causes a large steady-state error. Based on the analysis of the performance of LMS algorithm, an improved LMS algorithm based on the nonlinear relationship function between μ(k)and x(k) is proposed. The theoretical analysis and simulation results show that the vμ LMS algorithm can be compared. Good to overcome the inherent flaws of the LMS algorithm.

Author Keywords: LMS algorithm, adaptive filtering

articleTitle: Abstract Summarization Based on the Combination of Transformer and LSTM
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Summary is the task of compressing a piece of text into a short version with the main information of the original text. While previous architecture choices revolve around Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and long shortterm memory (LSTM) recurrent neural networks, recently self-attention and transformer have been used for the text generation task and achieved very good results. However transformer lacks local attention information and uses simple calculations as address vectors. In our article, we put forward a new seq-to-seq model for generating text summary called LTABS (Abstractive summarization on LSTM and Transformer). This model makes transformer be more suitable for summary generation tasks. For the encoder part of the model, we make use of the hidden layer result of LSTM as the location information. At the same time, transformer is used as the attention matrix of LSTM. This design allows the transformer to obtain location information and enhance local attention. We add copy mechanism to the new network to finish off the summary tasks OOV (out of vocabulary) problem. We apply our model to CNN and Daily Mail and Xsum datasets, the test outcome shows that the LTABS framework is superior to the most advanced model in semantic and syntactic structure, and has achieved competitive results in manual language quality assessment.

Author Keywords: transformer, abstractive summarization, position information

articleTitle: Model and Data Driven Complex Product Development: from V, Double Vs to Triple Vs
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Complex product development framework and methodology is evolving with the development of industrial technology, information technology and management technology. The traditional product development framework and methodology is a waterfall style, which is usually described as the V model. In the V model, the design result of the earliest stage will be validated, verified and accredited at the last stage. In order to reduce the cycle of verification, validation and accreditation (VV&A) and increase the probability of successful design within fewest iterations, model-based systems engineering (MBSE) proposes a design information transferring methodology based on digital models, which extends the V model to double Vs model. The development of big data technology and data-driven machine learning provides an opportunity to converge data lifecycle, model lifecycle and product development lifecycle together. The paper reviews product development models from V to double Vs, and presents a model and data driven triple Vs model for product development in the big data era.

Author Keywords: V Model, Product Development, MBSE

articleTitle: A Novel Assessment Method of Gate Oxide Degradation Based on IGBT Turn-on Losses for On-Line Reliability Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Insulated gate bipolar transistor (IGBT) is the core device of medium and high power converter, it widely used in new energy power generation, rail locomotive traction, electric vehicle drive, aerospace and other important fields, its operation reliability is great significance to ensure safe, reliable and efficient operation of the system. The gate oxygen layer is a relatively weak link with IGBT. Firstly, this paper analyzes the gate oxygen degradation mechanism of IGBT. Secondly, the influence of degradation fault of gate oxygen layer on the turn-on characteristics of IGBT is analyzed. Then, the simulation method of degradation fault of gate oxygen layer of IGBT is studied. Finally, based on the previous basis, the concept and monitoring method for characterizing the evolution of IGBT gate oxygen degradation by using the turn-on losses (Eon) is proposed, and verified by simulation and experiment. This method has the advantages of convenient measurement (no contact with IGBT), high accuracy and is suitable for on-line reliability condition monitoring and evaluation, it has important application value for the operation and maintenance and state prediction of power electronic devices and equipments.

Author Keywords: Insulated gate bipolar transistors, Gate oxygen degradation, Turn-on process energy losses, Reliability status monitoring

articleTitle: Research on Parking Space Prediction Based on Long Short-Term Memory
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: The berth occupancy prediction is a key issue in the intelligent parking guidance information system. Current neural network-based prediction techniques will dramatically decrease in prediction accuracy as the prediction step size increases. In order to solve the problem that the prediction accuracy of berth occupancy decreases with the increase of step size, we propose a time series prediction model based on long short-term memory (LSTM) neural network. The model enhances the memory function of the network by controlling the forget gate, output gate and input gate, filtering out relatively unimportant information and reducing the sample dependence of the model, thus it improves the training efficiency. The model is tested by using real parking data. The test results show that the proposed model has certain advantages in the accuracy of long-term prediction.

Author Keywords: Berth occupancy prediction, Time series prediction, long short-term memory

articleTitle: Design and Research of 6-DOF Robot Control System Based on Visual Servo
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In recent years, the development of robot technology is very rapid, and robots have been widely used in industry, agriculture, service, medical treatment, military and other fields. In the research of robotics, the research on the architecture of robot control system has always been a hot topic. The information the human brain obtains from the outside world mainly comes from visual perception. Under the general trend of the increasing development of artificial intelligence, it is very important to strengthen vision in robot technology. The vision system can map the three-dimensional object features to the two-dimensional image plane, and then use the obtained image information to control the robot. People want robots to have higher intelligence and stronger adaptability to the environment. The research of robot visual servo is just to meet this requirement. Based on the research of industrial robot control system, this paper focuses on the visual servo control system of 6-DOF robot, and analyzes the performance of the control system.

Author Keywords: Robots, Control system, Visual servo

articleTitle: The k-Q Analyze of LCLC Resonant Converter
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: LCLC resonant converter are often used in DC-DC energy transmission circuits, and are derived from LLC converter with higher efficiency. In the process of energy transmission, how to choose parameters reasonably is a very important issue. Fundamental harmonic approximation(FHA) was used in this paper, based on the bode diagrams analysis of different loads, the k-Q design criteria is proposed by studying the relationship among the parameters when the converter realizes zero-voltage-switching(ZVS): soft switching is implemented when the product of the square root of k<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>(the ratio of parallel and series resonant inductors) and Q(the quality factor) is no more than 1, there is one soft switching region when the product of the square root of the k<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>(the ratio of parallel and series resonant capacitors) and the inverse of Q is less than or equal to 1, and two independent soft switching regions when the product is more than 1. Satisfy this criterion will ensure converter ZVS and the criterion can be used to judge the condition of their work areas. Finally, a full-bridge LCLC resonant converter is built, simulation has proved the feasibility of the criteria.

Author Keywords: energy transmission, LCLC resonant converter, LLC resonant converter, soft-switching, ZVS, FHA

articleTitle: SCSCDaylight: Network Monitoring Tools for Software-Defined Networks Based on Opendaylight
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Monitoring is a foundation for network management. Timely and accurate network statistics is essential to critical network management task, such as traffic engineering, service-level agreement (SLA), anomaly detection and troubleshooting. However, in traditional networks, monitoring is difficult to achieve due to the lack of support by the equipment. Recently, software defined network (SDN) separates the network control plane from the data forwarding plane, and manages the network by the centralized controller which can access the underlying device data flexibly. In this paper, a Software-Defined Networks monitoring tools-SCSCDaylight is implemented based on opendaylight, which is an open source SDN controller platform. The tools support network topology partition, multiple controller collaboration, two-way link speed and packet loss rate measurement. And the network simulation is used to evaluate this system. The experimental results show that the tools can accurately implement the measurement of link speed and packet loss rate.

Author Keywords: Network Monitoring, SDN, Opendaylight

articleTitle: Research on Measurement Model of Water Content of Oil Well Based on Data Fusion
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Water content of oil well is an important parameter indicator for oilfield development. Since the measurement of water content is affected by many factors and the nonlinear relationship with its influencing factors is complex, the measurement accuracy is difficult to obtain satisfactory results. In this paper, the RF-based moisture detection method is combined with the multi-sensor data fusion technology. Based on the support vector machine optimized by genetic algorithm, an online water cut measurement model is established, which compensates for multiple parameters such as temperature, salinity and flow state. Through the learning and generalization of the sample data obtained by the experiment, the training and verification, the maximum error in the test data is less than 6%, indicating that the GA-SVM based measurement model can predict the crude oil moisture content with high precision.

Author Keywords: oil well water content, data fusion, support vector machine

articleTitle: Research on Application Layer Security Communication Protocol Based on Lightweight NTRU Public Key Cryptography
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: The development of mobile Internet technology has made intelligent terminal devices and mobile applications popular, and computing at mobile devices is becoming more and more popular in people's daily lives. However, due to the processing speed and storage capacity limitations of mobile terminal devices, their security has become a major bottleneck in the development of mobile computing. Therefore, security research for mobile platforms is of great significance. The cryptosystem is an important part of realizing the anonymous security of mobile Internet information transmission. In general, the cryptosystem includes a symmetric cryptosystem and a public-key cryptosystem, both of which have advantages and disadvantages. The symmetric cryptosystem algorithm is fast, but the encryption and decryption keys of the two sides of the communication are the same, which hinders the security implementation of the key management security core key negotiation, and cannot be applied with a digital signature. The public key cryptosystem can separate the encryption key from the decryption key, but its operation speed is slow and limited by the mobile hardware platform. The paper proposes communication encryption and signature algorithm for the mobile terminal, which uses the public key cryptography algorithm. Based on ensuring the same security as the traditional public key cryptography algorithm, the computational overhead is reduced, the running speed is increased, and the storage requirement is reduced.

Author Keywords: NTRU, Lightweight, Communication, security, Application layer

articleTitle: Analysis of Attribute Selection Method Based on IDOE in Software Fault Prediction
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: This paper presents a new attribute selection method based on Importance Descending Order Exclusion (IDOE) to predict software fault. By using public datasets CM1 and JM1 from PROMISE repository, six machine learning algorithms-Naïve Bayes, LibSVM, Logistic, Multilayer Perceptron, SMO and Random forests integrated in Weka are used for analysis. Firstly, the GeneticSearch and Ranker search method is chosen to select attributes. Secondly, these machine learning algorithms are used in order to predict precision, recall and F-measure of software modules. Then the IDOE method is used to update the attribute datasets. Finally, the different iteration experiment results are compared and analyzed.

Author Keywords: Importance Descending Order Exclusion, Software Fault Prediction

articleTitle: Web Crawler Scheduler Based on Coroutine
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: The application of coroutine has greatly accelerated the programs switching. Compared with threads and processes, it not only satisfies most applications, but also consumes very little system resources. This paper proposes a web crawler scheduler based on coroutine.

Author Keywords: coroutine, crawler, concurrence, scheduling

articleTitle: Text Mining Strategy of Power Customer Service Work Order Based on Natural Language Processing Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In order to improve the level of power customer service, we need to start with natural language processing technology, and conduct in-depth text mining of power customer complaint work order. Combined with the format and characteristics of power customer service work order, this paper proposed a text mining strategy of power customer service work order based on natural language processing technology which includes the following processes: work order data cleaning, text segmentation, information characterization, model training and model evaluation is proposed. The TF-IDF algorithm and the model optimization method based on accuracy calculation are applied in this strategy, which greatly improves the level of power customer service.

Author Keywords: Text mining, work order, NLP

articleTitle: Tongue Semantic Segmentation Based on Fully Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: It is difficult to accurately segment the tongue due to the blurred contours and the similar colors of the surrounding tissue. This paper presents a semantic segmentation method for tongue body based on fully convolutional neural network. First, the convolutional and pooling layers are used to map the tongue image from the pixel domain to the feature domain. Then, the deconvolutional layer is used to restore the shrinking feature image to the original size. Finally, the Softmax classifier is trained to classify each point of the image in order to achieve segmentation. Experimental results show that the method proposed in this paper can get better segmentation results, laying a solid foundation for tongue analysis and dialectical diagnosis.

Author Keywords: fully convolutional neural network, tongue segmentation, semantic segmentation, deconvolutional Introduction

articleTitle: Research on Automatic Decoding of Morse Code Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: The current automatic decoding method of the Morse telegram has limited accuracy, and can't adapt to signal distortion and code length deviation of the manual telegram. This paper introduces the deep learning method and constructs an automatic decoding model, which integrates feature extraction, sequence modeling and transcription into an end-to-end training neural network. The time-frequency diagrams of signals are used for training and testing. Experimental results show that the decoding system has strong adaptability to manual deviation and frequency drift, and is robust in a noisy environment.

Author Keywords: Morse code, automatic decoding, deep learning, frequency drift, Manual deviation

articleTitle: A RFF Access Authentication Technology Based on K-Nearest Neighbor Method
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Access security of wireless device is a great challenge to wireless communication networks, especially for radio frequency identification (RFID) and some other devices with limited computing power, which are faced with effective high-strength security challenges, and as an important non-cryptographic authentication technology, radio frequency fingerprinting (RFF) technology, for its full use of non-imitation radio frequency characteristics, attracts more and more attention. The generation mechanism of radio frequency fingerprint and the basic model of recognition system are described, and A RFF access authentication technology based on k-nearest neighbor (kNN) approach also is analyzed. In addition, the existing problems of radio frequency fingerprint recognition technology and the research direction of further improvement are pointed out.

Author Keywords: edge computing, edge devices, authentication, RFF, kNN

articleTitle: Modeling and Simulation for CBRN Hazard Source Item Estimation through Sensor Data Fusion
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: The parameter inversion of harmful gas diffusion source term is the inverse problem of harmful gas diffusion hazard assessment, which is of great significance to hazard prediction assessment and emergency response. Based on Bayesian reasoning method, using sensor detection data and forward atmospheric diffusion model, the likelihood function is constructed. Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) sampling is used to establish the source term parameter inversion algorithm, and the simulation platform is established by MATLAB software for simulation analysis. The simulation results show that the inversion results are in good agreement with the initial source parameters, which proves the feasibility of the method.

Author Keywords: source item estimation, sensor data fusion, Bayesian inference, Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC)

articleTitle: Optimizing Generative Adversarial Networks in Latent Space
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Recent GANs have achieved great progress in generating high quality images, however, GANs still suffer a lot from instability and mode collapse. In this work, we propose a new framework, Latent Optimization Generative Adversarial Networks (LO-GANs). We give a definition of mode collapse and derive that generator with capability of reconstructing training images alleviates the mode collapse. Moreover, this capability benefits the stability of GANs. Our method takes advantages of both GANs and non-adversarial methods, as it is capable of both reconstructing training images and generating new high-quality images. Instead of learning a images representation by employing an encoder, we directly optimize a learnable image representation set for image reconstruction. Besides image reconstruction, adversarial regularization is adopted to match the aggregated distribution of the latent image representation with arbitrary prior distribution. Our framework is flexible as it is implemented by adding a latent image representation set and a representation discriminator to vanilla GANs. Experimental results show that our models are capable of reconstructing training images and mode collapse is alleviated significantly. Benefitting from reconstructing constraints and latent image representation optimization, our models are more stable during training than vanilla GANs.

Author Keywords: image generation, optimization, neural nets

articleTitle: Deep Learning Model for Function Point Based Software Cost Estimation -An Industry Case Study
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Cost estimation of software engineering is a vital mission for software development organization. Accurate estimation can be valuable for both the developers and the customers. How to make estimation more accurate and reproducible is an important task to be settled in both research and industry area. This paper gives a review of the state of the art in the field of software cost estimation and proposes a Deep Neural Network(DNN) model to facilitate the usage of function point estimation. The results show that the function point based estimation can be a good choice in the early evaluation of the software budget while the deep neural network can significantly improve the labor productivity and the accuracy of the evaluation result .

Author Keywords: deep neural network, software cost estimation, function point

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Optimization of Single-Sided Linear Induction Motors Based on the Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: The single-sided linear induction motor have been used in urban rail transit. As the core of thrust in medium-low-speed maglev train systems, its performance directly affects the traction characteristics of the train. The discontinuous structure of a single-sided linear induction motor leads to the unique phenomena with end effects. It causes eddy current effects to generate braking force, weakens the thrust of the motor, meanwhile reduces motor efficiency and power factor. As the speed increases, these phenomena will become more and more serious. In this paper, an equivalent circuit model is carried out to study the influence of different design parameters on the performance of the single-sided linear induction motor. Then, establish an appropriate multi-objective function to optimize the design parameters of the motor by using genetic algorithm. which aims to reduce the weight of motor while maximizing thrust, power factor, and efficiency. Finally, the simulation model is established by using finite element software to verify the correctness of the optimization results.

Author Keywords: single-sided linear induction motor, end effect, multi-objective function, genetic algorithm

articleTitle: Face Swapping with Limited Input
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: We propose an end-to-end face swapping pipeline. To replace the faces in a video, we take in a single photo to produce the result, while previous methods either need sophisticated equipment or large amount of data. Our pipeline consists of three parts, expression transfer, details refining and merging back. By combing 3D model and Generative Adversarial Network, we show that our pipeline is easy to implement, and is able to produce decent results even with limited input.

Author Keywords: face swapping, 3D face animation, Generative Adversarial Network

articleTitle: Dialog Acts Classification with Semantic and Structural Information
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Dialog act, which is an essential element in dialog systems, plays an important role in understanding users' intents in the human-computer dialog. With the increasing applications of deep learning in natural language processing, more and more researchers adopt methods of text classification to identify dialog acts. However, sometimes one utterance may correspond to multiple labels, which leads to a cumbersome problem in classifying dialog acts. In this paper, we propose a multi-label classification model for solving this issue. Meanwhile, as Graph Convolutional Network can extract spatial features of topological graphs, we utilize it to capture syntactic information to enrich the words' semantic representations. In addition, due to the fact that one utterance consists of different clauses and each clause may correspond to one act label, we associate the relationship between clauses through Recurrent Neutral Network. Finally, our model combines the above two-level representations together. Compared with other classification models, experimental results can verify that our proposed model performs better.

Author Keywords: Dialog Acts, Multi-label Classification, Syntactic Dependency, Graph Neural Network, Clause Segmentation

articleTitle: Kinematics Analysis and Simulation of ABB Robot Based on MATLAB
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In order to better control the robot for precise operation, taking ABB IRB 1410 robot as an example, the structure and connecting rod parameters of D-H representation are used to analyze, the forward and inverse solutions of the robot are obtained by MATLAB, and its kinematics is analyzed. Finally, the workspace of the robot is calculated by MATLAB software, and the trajectory of the robot's end manipulator is planned.

Author Keywords: ABB Robot, Kinematics Analysis, MATLAB

articleTitle: Lane Detection of Unstructured Roads Based on WS-P2PNet
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Lane detection, as a foundational computer vision task, is the key technique in autonomous lane keeping system. Compared with structured lane which has clear boundary information, Unstructured lanes such as rural road and urban lane are hard to detect since they lack distinct recognized symbols. This study proposes a new network to detect this kind of unstructured lanes. First, the improved pix2pix named WS-P2PNet is used as backbone network. It can predict the location of the lane. Then, then bottom layer of WS-P2PNet is followed by SCNN which is used to enable message passing between pixels across rows and columns in a layer. Finally, an extensive evaluation of the proposed method is conducted over CULane, and compared with different kind of lane detection algorithms. The results demonstrate that the proposed method achieves a highly satisfactory performance.

Author Keywords: CNNs, unstructured lane, Generative Adversarial Networks, lane detection

articleTitle: Simulation and Test Research of Tracked Vehicle Ride Comfort
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Based on the establishment of the dynamic model of the tracked vehicle and the measured road surface model, the simulation of ride comfort is conducted by using the virtual prototype technology in this paper. Through choosing the vehicle equipped with different schemes of suspension device, the data of two test points of the vehicle are obtained and processed respectively. Then compared the test data with the simulation data, the result shows that the simulation model has good reliability to be used to evaluate and improve the performance of tracked vehicle ride comfort and the test method is reasonable and feasible.

Author Keywords: tracked vehicle, ride comfort, virtual prototype, test

articleTitle: Design of Patrol Monitoring and Control System for Hot Spot of Solar Photovoltaic Module
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In this paper, a hot spot detection and monitoring system based on UAV is proposed. The system uses UAV to carry thermal imager and cruise automatically to collect images and transmit them back to the ground station control system. The real-time image processing of the ground station detects hot spots and saves the inspection results to the local database, and can encode and output the inspection video containing the hot spot location.

Author Keywords: UAV, Hot Spot Detection, Monitoring System, Image Processing

articleTitle: An Intelligent Bearing Fault Diagnosis Method with Transfer Learning from Artificial Damage to Real Damage
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Traditional intelligent fault diagnosis methods for bearings have achieved much success when the training data and testing data are collected from the same type of damage generation. In actual industrial environments, it is difficult to collect enough real damaged samples, but artificial damaged samples are easy to obtain. In this paper, a novel transfer learning method with convolutional neural network (CNN) from artificial damage to real damage for bearing fault diagnosis is proposed. Firstly, the CNN model is constructed and pre-trained by huge and easily obtained artificial damaged samples. Then, parameters of some layers from the pre-trained CNN model are frozen to save the same feature between artificial damaged samples and real damaged samples. Finally, a small number of real damaged samples are used to fine-tune the model. Experiments on an open bearing fault database showed that the proposed method can not only improve the diagnosis accuracy in the real damage dataset, but also save training time and samples. The superiority of the proposed method is also proved by comparing with other classical methods and visualizing the learned features of the networks.

Author Keywords: intelligent fault diagnosis, transfer learning, convolutional neural network, artificial damage, real damage

articleTitle: NS-3 Based Simulation and Analyse for WLAN Based Wireless Self-Organization Link
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In emergency data communication, a portable, efficient handheld device based data link is very useful. So the WLAN based Wireless Self-organization Link (WSOL) system is suitable for this case. WSOL is a multihop linear wireless network with relays between source and destination node. The communication link can be set up automatically and optimally. The capacity of WSOL can be well reflected by simulation. Understanding the parameter variation of WSOL helps us to build the testbed system and analyze the field trial results. In this paper, we use Network Simulator 3 (NS-3) as the network simulator to build the testbed of WSOL and simulated the system's throughput, delay, jitter and packet loss rate. We discussed the simulation result and gave some suggestions for improvement.

Author Keywords: Ad Hoc, MANET, WLAN, NS-3, OpenWrt

articleTitle: Personal Health Monitoring System Based on Body Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Body sensor networks (BSN) is a wireless communication network that has been paid more and more attention. It consists of sensor nodes and personal intelligent terminals distributed on body or pasted on clothes. The personal health monitoring BSN bases on ZigBee and Bluetooth, which controls sensor nodes for acquiring of human heart rate, temperature, blood pressure and other vital parameters in real time, and displays vital signs on the intelligent terminal to further implement the remote data interaction with community hospital or central hospital.

Author Keywords: Body Sensor Networks, Sensor Node, Vital Signs, Wireless Communication Transmission

articleTitle: A Deep Learning Based Personnel Positioning System for Key Cabin of Ship
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: With the development of ship information and intelligence, and the gradual deepening of ship safety management, ship personnel safety and damage disposal personnel positioning and other related research has attracted more and more attention. Deep learning technology is widely applied in various industries and fields through features extraction, multi-stage learning and complete expression. This paper studies the personnel positioning system of the ship's key cabin based on deep learning, aiming to provide auxiliary Suggestions and command decisions for the ship's commander through the application of intelligent technology.

Author Keywords: Ship, personnel positioning system, deep learning

articleTitle: Image Segmentation Algorithm Based on the Background Skeleton Feature
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In order to improve the segmentation accuracy of adhered rice images, an automatic segmentation algorithm for adhered rice images based on background skeleton features is proposed. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm can adapt well to the adhesion segmentation of different grains under complex condition. Compared with the classic distance transformation watershed algorithm and the improved watershed algorithm, Algorithm accuracy has improved a lot, and the formed grain segmentation boundary is smoother, with less influence on the shape.

Author Keywords: Adhesive rice, Image Segmentation, Background skeleton feature, Endpoint matching

articleTitle: Exploration of Influencing Factor Dependency of Taxi Drivers' Decisions Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In order to explore the influencing factor dependency of taxi drivers' decision-making, the data sets of taxi GPS are used as the initial data set, and Hongqiao Airport is used as stand to conduct research and analysis, data cleaning and feature engineering are implemented, and the importance and dependency of each feature are calculated with XGBoost. In order to solve the serious imbalance of the data set, the SMOTEENN method in mixed sampling is used to improve this situation. The Stacking thinking in ensemble learning is combined with neural networks and traditional machine learning algorithms (GBDT, random forest, K-nearest neighbor, XGBoost), we can build a two-level stacking model which takes Logistic Regression as meta classifier, and finally analyze the influencing factors of taxi driver's decision and their influencing strength sorting.

Author Keywords: machine learning, deep learning, taxi drivers' decision.

articleTitle: HardStack: Prevent Stack Buffer Overflow Attack with LBR
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Stack buffer overflow attack can temper with software control flow by continuously injecting data into stack and overwriting function return address. In this paper, we propose a new method to solve buffer overflow attack with the support of Intel LBR, which we call it HardStack. Usually, the function return address is stored in the stack, and it is easy to be overwritten. In our opinion, HardStack changes this situation. In HardStack, the return address is calculated on hardware information and software information together. In this way, even if the attacker tampers with the data in the stack, he fail to hijack the software control flow without modifying on LBR. Our discussion show that HardStack increases the delay by thousands of times in a certain call, but which has no obvious effect on the running of the software.

Author Keywords: buffer overflow, LBR, control flow

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of a Hexagonal Microstrip Array Antenna with OAM
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: With the rapid development of communication technology, the contradiction between the demand of wireless channel capacity and the shortage of spectrum resources becomes more and more prominent. Based on the theory of orbital angular momentum and microstrip array technology, a vortex electromagnetic wave microstrip array antenna with hexagonal patch structure is designed. According to the simulation results, the effectiveness of hexagon patch structure in improving the bandwidth of microstrip antenna is analyzed. The antenna covers the operating frequency band of 9.2GHz-10.5GHz, its -10dB BW reaches 12.7%, and generates 15 different modes of effective eddy electromagnetic beam. The results of electromagnetic simulation show that the multi-element microstrip array antenna can generate more modal vortex electromagnetic beams efficiently.

Author Keywords: orbital angular momentum, hexagonal patch, multimodal, microstrip array, electric field vectogram

articleTitle: Automatic Reading and Writing Model of Welding Parameters Predicted Based on PSO-RFR
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: The parameters in welding process are the key factors which affecting the quality of the welding. The cold rolling mill of a steel factory has improved the welding quality and welding automation level of the welder, and realized the goal of factory wisdom manufacturing gradually, plans to improve equipment to upgrade and optimize parameters used to. In this paper, an automatic reading and writing model for the welding parameters is designed. The random forest regression model based on particle swarm optimization (PSO-RFR) is used to predict the welding parameters, which replaces the manual modification work of workers and completes the intelligent transformation work. Meanwhile, the model accuracy is assessed well. The welding parameters of the algorithm predicted have been tested in actual production process, which has a good prediction effect.

Author Keywords: automatic reading and writing model, welding parameters, Random Forest Regression, Particle Swarm Optimization, PSO-RFR

articleTitle: A New Analytical Inverse Kinematics Model for Seven Degrees of Freedom Redundant Manipulators
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: As the seven degrees of freedom redundant manipulator has a superior performance in wide fields of applications, this paper proposes a new analytical inverse kinematics model for seven degrees of freedom redundant manipulators. Specifically, it focuses on how to derive equations for the feasible space of the endpoint of each joint and correspondingly the feasible space of each arm-angle given the endpoint of the manipulator, which can be used for the optimal path planning of robotic obstacle avoidance. Firstly, the spatial structure of the manipulator is decoupled using the space geometry and parameterization method. Secondly, the structure model of each part after decoupled and the feasible space of the endpoint of each joint are obtained. Then, the feasible space is applied to obtain the feasible space of the arm-angle. Finally, the validity of the method is verified by simulations.

Author Keywords: inverse kinematic, feasible space, arm-angle, 7-DoF redundant manipulators

articleTitle: A Design of Hull Coating Robot Based on Mecanum Wheel and Electromagnet
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Hull coating robot is of great importance in ship building industry. In this paper, a novel coating robot with four electromagnets and Mecanum wheels are proposed and designed. Firstly, compared with other kinds of adsorption forms and driving forms, a better solution with electromagnets and Mecanum wheels is proposed. Secondly, the electromagnet related calculations are taken, and the relationship among magnetic force, distance and current is obtained. Sequentially, two kinds of suspension systems are proposed including a normal and a reverse form. Then, the relationship diagram between wheel height variation and force is founded. The analysis results indicate that the reverse form is better. Finally, the reverse form of suspension system is designed.

Author Keywords: hull coating, Mecanum wheel, electromagnetic force, suspension system

articleTitle: Research on Effectiveness Evaluation of Equipment Maintenance Support Based on Simulation
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: This paper studies the effectiveness evaluation of equipment maintenance support in the field of equipment support. Firstly, we propose a multi-layer equipment maintenance support efficiency evaluation index system, and model the problem as a weight distribution problem. Then we design a combination weighting method combining improved analytic hierarchy process (AHP) and principal component analysis (PCA) to effectively solve the problem of consistency of judgment matrix and subjective arbitrariness when there are too many indicators in AHP. We invited experts in the field of equipment maintenance support to use the 1-9 scale method to rate the importance of two indicators, and conducted 100 times of simulation of equipment maintenance support process through the distributed simulation system called Anylogic. The experimental results show that the subjective and objective combination weighting method solves the problem of effectiveness evaluation of equipment maintenance support, and is of great significance to the establishment and improvement of equipment maintenance support system.

Author Keywords: equipment maintenance support
effectiveness evaluation
analytic hierarchy process (AHP)
principal component analysis (PCA)

articleTitle: Research on Anti Fading Transmission Technology of Improved HARQ Scheme in Space Optical Communication
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: The multiphase screen numerical simulation method is used to simulate the fading variation caused by atmospheric turbulence in the laser communication link. Based on the traditional chase Hybrid Automatic Repeat Request scheme, the improved anti-fading scheme is studied. The simulation results show that the improved scheme combining multiframe interleaving and traditional HARQ anti-fading scheme can effectively avoid a series of errors and cause deep fading problems, and reduce the average bit error rate of the system compared to the long interleaving scheme. Comparing the traditional chase-type HARQ scheme also reduces the average bit error rate of the system and improves the throughput of the system.

Author Keywords: atmospheric turbulence, anti-fading, hybrid automatic request, bit error rate

articleTitle: Disaster Transmission Network Based on Next-Generation Video Standard
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: This paper mainly designed a disaster transmission network. The network consists of a terrestrial sensor network, a terrestrial Mesh network, and a satellite ground network. The network collects terrestrial sensor information and transmits it remotely by satellite. In order to save scarce satellite terrestrial bandwidth resources, we propose a disaster transmission network and routing strategy based on the new generation video coding standard H.265. The design architecture of this paper can complete the remote sensing task of disaster transmission, and the transmission bandwidth is greatly reduced compared with the traditional architecture when transmitting the same quality video, which provides a guarantee for preventing or defensing disasters.

Author Keywords: terrestrial sensor network, Mesh network, satellite ground network, H.265, disaster defense.

articleTitle: Visual Query Method for Large Blackouts Based on Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Large blackouts are inevitable and happen from time to time. At present, a large amount of data about large blackouts is published on the Internet. Though many outstanding works have achieved great success for analysis of the reasons. How to process large scale data in Chinese on the internet for reason analysis is still a great challenge. To tackle this problem, we propose a visual query method for large blackouts based on the knowledge graph. The web crawler and knowledge graph have been employed in this paper. Firstly, a great amount of data in Chinese is crawled from the internet. Secondly, information about the event entity, relation and attribute can be extracted with a deep learning method. Thirdly, a large blackouts knowledge graph can be built from the information related to those events. Finally, visual queries of nodes, relations, and paths for large blackouts based on the knowledge graph are implemented. In this paper, a visual query method for large blackouts information, relations between different accidents, the path among entity nodes is present. it can help to analyze a large amount of data about large blackouts to improve the safety of the power system.

Author Keywords: Large Blackouts, Knowledge Graph, Deep Learning

articleTitle: The Hybrid Dynamic Stock Forecasting Model Based on ANN and SVR
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Lately, mass hybrid time series models have yet been applied to settle complexity nonlinear and financial issues. Nevertheless, some hybrid models have limitations, and the accuracy of separate forecasting model needs to be improved. Therefore, this paper demonstrates a novel hybrid dynamic stock time series forecasting model depended on ANN and SVR, which can be used to avoid that disadvantages mentioned hereinbefore. First, the appropriate data preprocessing is carried out to improve the quality of the feature. Second, it applies ANN and SVR to forecast the fluctuation of stock. Third, it improves the accuracy of prediction by dynamic adjustment bias. To evaluate the proposed hybrid and dynamic model, we used China stock exchange data as the datasets which from June 8, 2015 to May 26, 2016. The results clearly display that the offered model makes result reach a more precise prediction, and the accuracy can be achieved 79%.

Author Keywords: Hybrid dynamic model, stock forecasting, time series, ANN, SVR

articleTitle: Fixed-Time Average Consensus for Multi-Agent Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: First and foremost, a distributed control protocol is proposed in order to making the first-order multi-agent systems (MASs) get to FTAC. Secondly, the sufficient conditions for the system to be consistent under the controller are given. Finally, the conclusion is verified by a numerical simulation.

Author Keywords: Multi-agent Systems, fixed-time average consensus

articleTitle: Multilevel Image Thresholding Based on Adaptive Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In this paper, an adaptive particle swarm optimization (APSO) algorithm is utilized to search the optimal multilevel threshold value using Otsu as its objective function. The PSNR is adopted to evaluate the effect of image segmentation. The simulation results proved that the APSO is suitable for multilevel thresholding image segmentation.

Author Keywords: APSO, multilevel thresholds, image segmentation, Otsu

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Multi-source Dynamic Information Acquisition System Based on ARM for Mine Trackless Rubber Wheeled Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Studying the multi-source dynamic information acquisition system of mine explosion-proof trackless rubber-tyred vehicle is of great significance for standardizing the use of explosion-proof trackless rubber-tyred vehicle and reducing potential safety hazards in coal mines. Combining sensor technology, wireless communication technology and embedded technology, this paper studies the types of data acquisition of explosion-proof trackless rubber-tyred vehicle and the monitoring methods of corresponding sensor elements. On this basis, the storage scheme, storage mechanism, Bluetooth transmission mechanism based on ARM MCU and PDA data reading method are studied. Through the design of system structure and software and hardware, not only the operation parameters of explosion-proof trackless rubber-tyred vehicle can be monitored, but also the real-time collection, transmission, storage and reading of surrounding environment data can be realized, which makes up for the defect that the existing system can not store multi-parameters independently.

Author Keywords: trackless rubber tyred-vehicle, multi-source dynamic information, ARM, Bluetooth transmission

articleTitle: Recognition Algorithm of Rice Germ Integrity Base on Improved Inception v3
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: This paper adopts a deep learning inceptionv3 as a framework, improves a loss function and adds large boundary regularization parameters, thereby increasing an inter-class difference of germ integrity; and moreover, this paper adds new loss function for feedback, identifies an inter-class boundary of the germ integrity and learns different local features, i.e. different germ integrity features of rice grains on different channels. The original dropout is improved and added to an orthogonal classification layer to reduce the unnecessary link weight of different germ integrity classes, thereby identifying the germ integrity of the rice. The experiment result shows that the proposed algorithm has high identification rate for identifying the integrity of the milled rice with germs, and the comprehensive segmentation accuracy is 94.12%. Compared with other classical identification, the accuracy of the algorithm is greatly improved.

Author Keywords: Rice germ integrity, Image Identification, Convolutional Neural Network

articleTitle: Study on Wing Geometry for the Influence of Flapping Wing Aerodynamic Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: The planar shapes of different insect wings are quite different in nature. The surface of the wings is covered with crisscrossed veins and wing membranes of various shapes, and the pleated structure which also has some differences in different extensions. These various geometric features inevitably have an important impact on their flight performance. At present, the production of the flapping wing micro aerial vehicle prototype is often biased towards the design of the transmission mechanism, but the geometric features are not fully considered in the flapping wing design. It calculated the aerodynamic performance of different wing plane shapes and pleated structures in hovering state, and analyzed the area distribution of the wing plane shape and the difference of the pleated structure for the impact of flapping aerodynamics and flow field structure, which provides a theoretical basis for the design of bionic wings with excellent flight capabilities.

Author Keywords: micro aerial vehicle, flapping wing, insect, shape

articleTitle: Research on Numerical Simulation Technology of Spiral Plate Heat Exchanger
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: For the spiral plate heat exchanger, because of its complicated structure, it is difficult to perform accurate design with the conventional design method. For the numerical simulation, however, as there are many coils and many distance columns in the spiral plate heat exchanger and nonlinear contacts are involved in the normal operation, it would be very hard or even impossible to perform computation if the whole equipment is modeled. In this paper, the numerical simulation technology of the spiral plate heat exchanger regarding the strength and instability of the inside plate is studied. Results show that instead of the whole spiral plate heat exchanger model, a single-layer chamber model is capable to analyze the strength and instability of the plate with enough accuracy.

Author Keywords: spiral plate heat exchanger, spacing column, finite element analysis, stability analysis, heat exchanger design

articleTitle: Pedestrian Partial Occlusion Detection Method Based on Improved YOLO Network Structure
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: The problem of pedestrian detection accuracy is low due to partial occlusion of pedestrians in practical application scenarios, a pedestrian occlusion detection method based on improved YOLOv3 network structure is proposed. By improving the activation function and clustering method to strengthen the feature output layer of the shallow layer of the network, which effectively make the accuracy of detection better. The experimental results show that the mAP of proposed method is improved by 2.63 percent in the INRIA data set, and the improved network has good robustness and generalization ability, and guarantees the real-time of detection.

Author Keywords: pedestrian detection, YOLOv3, activation function, clustering method

articleTitle: Design of an Ontology Model Based Ship Condition Monitoring Middleware
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: It is important for the ship automation management to implement the ship condition monitoring and real-time fault early warning. In order to improve the efficiency of data collection and intelligence of ship monitoring, a ship monitoring ontology model is proposed by using Web Ontology Language (OWL) and a reason manager is designed by using Semantic Web Rule Language (SWRL). Besides, Java Expert Shell System (JESS) based reason machine is implemented to integrate the ship condition monitoring ontology and inference rules. A test bed is developed to verify the performance of the middleware system with real-time sensor data. The results show that the proposed middleware can improve the accuracy and decrease the warning delay compared with existed traditional monitoring system.

Author Keywords: Ship condition monitoring, ontology modeling, reason rule, context aware

articleTitle: On the Analysis of Multi-Point Crowd Gathering in Designated Areas
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In recent years, there have been frequent international social unrest, such as the yellow vest movement in France, the subway crisis in Chile, the brexit march and other violent conflicts, which have brought incalculable losses to the public, and the social service capacity of relevant public institutions of the government has been greatly reduced. Therefore, it is a practical and meaningful problem to analysis the multi-point crowd gathering of people in the relevant key locations in the urban hot spots. However most of the research on papers focused on the gathering of people in a single place, which is not enough to support the analysis of the crowd gathering in multiple places. In this paper, a multi-point crowd gathering analysis method named AMPCG is proposed, it innovatively weighted the distance of multiple key points in a designated area, combined with crowd traffic patterns in every point. The results show that AMPCG can accurately analysis crowd gathering in multiple points in a designated region.

Author Keywords: Designated area, multi-point, crowd gathering analysis

articleTitle: Detection of Threat Situation for UAV Collision Avoidance Based on Sliding Window Polynomial Fitting Prediction Method
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: The detection of air threat situation is the key to the early warning for UAV flight collision avoidance. For this reason, a detection method of air threat situation based on sliding window polynomial fitting prediction is proposed. Firstly, the sliding window polynomial fitting method is used to dynamically predict the track of the intruder. Then, on the basis of the track prediction, using the flight information of UAV and intruder, the detection and alarm for flight conflict trend between UAV and intruder is carried out in a specific flight scenario. Simulation validates the effectiveness of the proposed method and the feasibility of application in the early warning for UAV flight collision avoidance.

Author Keywords: UAV, Collision avoidance, Threat situation, Sliding window, Polynomial fitting
