articleTitle: Research on Key Technology of Enterprise Private Cloud Anti-Leakage
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: With the rapid development of Internet and cloud computing technology, more and more enterprises use private cloud for collaborative work. Important data protection has become the focus of enterprise security protection. Based on the need of data anti-leakage, content monitoring and filtering security techniques were studied. And the private cloud anti-leakage prototype system was realized, which provided real-time monitoring for internal staff's intentional or unintentional leakages and the leakages caused by the implantation of malicious code from external attackers. When sending files containing pre-set sensitive words, the system will remind the user and inform the administrator. The received document is embedded with executable script code or the document itself is binary code, and dynamic and static combination detection will be performed. If the document includes malicious code, then warning information will timely feedback to the administrator to strengthen the enterprise information security management.

Author Keywords: private cloud, anti-leakage, dynamic and static detection, sensitive words, malicious code

articleTitle: A Lightning Trip Automatic Identification Method for EHV Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: This paper introduces an automatic identification method for lightning strikes of EHV transmission lines. The method is based on historical data, obtained a conclusions that Logistic regression model is better. Finally, a automatic Identification Algorithm of EHV transmission lines lightning trip based on Logistic Regression has been proposed, which have shown that a good engineering application value by way of example tests.

Author Keywords: EHV Transmission Lines, Lightning trip, Logistic Regression, Automatic Identification Method

articleTitle: The Search and Improvement of DES Algorithm for Data Transmission Security in SCADA
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: With the application of SCADA (Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition) is becoming more and more extensive in the national critical infrastructure. At the same time, compared with conventional control system, the data communication of SCADA system becomes more diverse and complex, and the communication system is more likely to be attacked, so improving the level of information security of SCADA system is very important and urgent. However, the wide application of DES has a short key in the world, which cannot meet the demand of the current network security. In this paper, ADES (Advanced Data Encryption Standard) algorithm is proposed and implemented in the C++ language, which is based on the deep research of data encryption methods and DES algorithm particularly. The method extends the length of DES from 64 bits to 128 bits. The function of ADES algorithm is closed to SM4 by experimental result, so the ADES can well meet the requirement of data transmission security.

Author Keywords: component, SCADA system, data transmission security, DES encryption algorithm, SM4 national encryption algorithm

articleTitle: Dynamic Scheduling Model of Intelligent Rail-Guided Vehicles Based on Dynamic Programming
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Rail-guided vehicles (RGVs) is widely used in logistics production processes to process Computer number controllers (CNCs). How to use RGV with maximum efficiency is an urgent problem to be solved. The objective of this paper is to establish and evaluate the RGVs scheduling strategies of a flexible manufacturing system (FMS). To tackle this problem, this paper comprehensively uses the enumeration method, traversal search, state transition judgment, global optimization and computer simulation, based on dynamic programming model, to establish an RGV dynamic scheduling model. Then we establish an algorithm to solve the model. Data-based computer simulations are used to test the proposed model. The experimental results show that the model has good practicability and the algorithm is effective.

Author Keywords: Dynamic programming model, RGV scheduling, global optimization

articleTitle: The Joint Simulation of Marine Dual Fuel Engine
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Based on Wärtsilä 9L34DF marine dual fuel engine, and the mathematical model of the 9L34DF was established by using BOOST for Static simulation, the models were configured according to the technical parameters of the actual equipment. To keep the engine speed constant, the simulation of four gradient working conditions of 100%, 85%, 75% and 50% in gas mode was carried out, and the simulation results were verified. In order to study the dynamic characteristics of the 9L34DF, the joint simulation of AVL BOOST and Matlab was realized by configuring the extended interface of the software kernel. The Simulink control model of the engine under the gas mode was set up, taking the fuel supply of the engine as a variable, and the intake of circulating air remains constant. Two sets of simulation constraints were set and the joint simulation study was carried out respectively. Through the calculation and analysis of the simulation results, the optimum air-fuel ratio under 750rpm and 100% working conditions was obtained.

Author Keywords: dual fuel engine, static simulation, control model, joint simulation

articleTitle: A Novel Junction Temperature Extraction Technology of On-Line Reliability State Detection for IGBT Module
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In recent years, IGBT (Insulated Gate Bipolar Transistor) is being more and more widely used in many fields such as new energy generation system, electric vehicle, smart grid and so on. To keep IGBT run stably and reliably is the basis of normal operation of these equipments so the reliability state detection of IGBT modules has become one of the research hotspots in power electronics fields. Many existing researches show that the key factor that determines the failure of IGBT modules and affects their reliability is temperature, which means that the junction temperature of IGBT modules is closely related to its reliability. Therefore, a novel junction temperature extraction technology of IGBT module for on-line reliability state detection is proposed in this paper. Apparently different from thermosensitive parameter which is of low measurement accuracy and poor real-time performance, the IGBT turn-off loss parameter has the advantages of quick response, easy detection and no damage to IGBT structure. This paper describes the correlation between junction temperature and turn-off loss principally and establish a 3D database of current, IGBT turn-off loss and temperature at the rated voltage. Through the theoretical analysis, simulation results and physical verification, it can be obviously figured out that this novel technology is feasible and effective.

Author Keywords: Insulated gate bipolar transistors, formatting, reliability, turn-off loss, junction temperature extraction

articleTitle: Sentence-SFV Model: Make Full Use of Word Embedding Actively
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Word Embedding is a method that can learn and capture the grammatical and semantic features contained in the corpus through unsupervised training. Because of this superior characteristic, it is very common to use word vectors as inputs in the downstream tasks. However, little attention has been paid to the active mining of semantic information carried by word vectors. Therefore, we propose a Sentence based Scenario Feature Vector (Sentence-SFV) Model to represent the scenario related grammatical features of sentences quantitively in vector form. With the help of Sentence-SFV model, we extract scenario related features of different corpora and project them into a 3D feature space for visual analysis, by which means we demonstrate the interesting ability of our model like distinguishing grammatical features and explaining grammatical differences between different corpora. We also discuss on the methods to further improve our model, and verify the improvement effect by apply optimized SFV in CNN based sentiment classification experiments.

Author Keywords: Text classification, sentiment analysis, deep learning, attention mechanism, word embedding

articleTitle: An Algorithm for Detecting Trickle Charge of Electric Bicycle Charging
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: With the popularity of electric bicycles, the potential safety problems such as battery heating and self ignition caused by overcharge of electric vehicles are increasingly prominent. In order to make the battery fully charged and eliminate the hidden danger of overcharge, a trickle charge detection algorithm is proposed and applied to a smart socket. The proposed algorithm combines many technologies such as segmented detection, current gradient change and least square method to realize the accurate detection of trickle charging process for different chargers, which are connected to the smart socket. After the charger enters the trickle charging for 1 hours, the power source is cut immediately to ensure that the battery is fully charged but not overcharged. The technology has been applied to products, and hundreds of test results show that the time error of the proposed trickle charge detection algorithm is less than 5 minutes, and the probability of missing and wrong inspection is zero.

Author Keywords: electric bicycle, intelligent charging socket, charging control, trickle charging, least square method

articleTitle: A Duplication Reduction Approach for Unstructured Data Using Machine Learning Method
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: With the development of the Internet technology, the data becomes more and more large, and occupy more and more storage space. Although the price of storage is becoming much cheaper than before, the physical space and the electric power consuming is still large, making much load when operating. In this paper, we propose a new method for duplicated unstructured data reduction. Firstly, we compute the features for all of our unstructured data, and then compare the them with other files in the filesystem. We remove the files with the high similarity and only leave one file. In this way, we can reduce many of duplicate files. We conduct experiments on real-world data. The results suggest the effectiveness of our method.

Author Keywords: big data, data reduction, data compression, data duplication

articleTitle: Network Location Information Hiding Algorithm Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In order to improve the security of network location information, it is necessary to design the network location information hiding, and an information hiding technology is proposed based on machine learning in cloud computing environment. The spatial geometry method is used to calculate the grid density of the network location information distribution, and the chaotic encryption method is used to encode the hidden location information data. The classification feature selection method is used to analyze the source of network location information transmission in cloud computing environment, and the encryption key construction of network location information is realized by combining random coding technology. The machine learning algorithm is used to optimize the network location information hiding process, and the network location information hiding is realized. The simulation results show that the proposed method has good encryption performance and strong anti-attack ability. It can effectively avoid the information leakage of network location and improve the ability of privacy protection.

Author Keywords: machine learning, network location, information hiding, encryption

articleTitle: Lightning Discharge Characteristics of Carbon Fiber Reinforced Polymer (CFRP) Wind Turbine Blade
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Different type of composite materials are being used in the main beam of wind turbine blade (WTB). In this paper, carbon fiber reinforced polymer (CFRP) composite material is used in the main beam of wind turbine blade, due to its conductive material property it is protected with the metallic mesh as lightning protection system (LPS). 3D electrostatic simulation based on finite element method (FEM) and high voltage strike test were performed on the scaled 5m long blade to investigate the lightning discharge characteristics of carbon fiber reinforced polymer wind turbine blade. The effect of conductive material, metallic mesh and wind turbine blade orientation are analyzed. Simulation and experimental results show that CFRP conductive material and metallic mesh has no significant effect on the lightning attachment to the wind turbine blade. Interception efficiency of the tip receptor decreases when wind turbine blade orientation moves from vertical position to the horizontal position. Results will help to improve the lightning interception efficiency of lightning protection system of the carbon fiber reinforced polymer wind turbine blade.

Author Keywords: carbon fiber reinforced polymer, wind turbine blade, metallic mesh, lightning protection system, finite element method, lightning attachment, receptor

articleTitle: Monitoring and Research on the Displacement and Deformation of Transmission Line Towers Based on Beidou Monitoring Data
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: The Beidou is a satellite-based radio satellite navigation and positioning system, which has the functions of intelligence, global, all-weather, continuous and real-time precision three-dimensional navigation and positioning, and has good anti-interference and security. The application of engineering survey, aerial photogrammetry, ocean measurement, city survey and so on has been applied in the fields of military, traffic, communication, resources, management and so on and has been widely used. The basic structure, measurement principle and Beidou satellite positioning error of global positioning system (Beidou) are described and analyzed in this paper. Measures to be taken against Beidou errors.

Author Keywords: Beidou, transmission line tower, compact radio navigation receiver, positioning

articleTitle: Study of a Code Comment Decision Method Based on Structural Features
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Code comment is one of the most effective ways to help programmers to understand the source code. High-quality comment decisions can not only cover the core code snippets in the software system but also avoid generating redundant code comments. However, in actual development, there is no uniform comment specification, and most of the comment decisions depend on personal experience and domain knowledge. This paper has learned a common comment decision specification from a large number of code comment examples to assist programmers in making appropriate comment decisions during code development. This paper proposes a method to extract the code structure from the context code of the current code line, and use the machine learning algorithm to determine the possibility that the current code needs to add comments. The proposed method was evaluated on 8 well-known open-source Python projects in GitHub and the experimental results show the feasibility and effectiveness of the method in some code types.

Author Keywords: code comment, comment decision, imblanced data, machine learning

articleTitle: Design of Compact Microstrip Antenna for GPS Applications
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In radio communication system, antenna is becoming more and more important. A circularly polarized GPS terminal receiving antenna is proposed in this paper. It is formed by a radiant patch, a feed probe and a substrate. The center frequency of the proposed antenna is 1.575+/-10 (GHz), the return loss is less than -20dB, and the axial ratio is less than 2.5. Simulation results demonstrate that the designed antenna can meet the requirements of GPS applications.

Author Keywords: Circular Polarization, Microstrip Antenna, GPS, Miniaturization

articleTitle: Navel Orange Recognition Method Based on Improved Otsu Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: An improved Otsu threshold segmentation algorithm with filling a circle method based on the center of mass(FCCM) is proposed to solve the problems of missing regional feature information and unsatisfactory effect in navel orange recognition by traditional image processing method. We first choose the appropriate color model. By analyzing the data, YCbCr model has better contrast compared with other color models, and the histogram of its Cr component has obvious peaks and troughs, which is conducive to image segmentation. We then segmented the extracted Cr component images by Otsu threshold segmentation algorithm. And further processing is carried out in combination with morphology and hole filling algorithm to make the image coherent, so as to ensure that the feature information of navel orange is not easy to be missing. And next, the center of mass of the image is determined and the radius of the detection circle is calculated by stepping method. Finally, the noise points outside the radius of the detection circle are eliminated and the recognition results are displayed in the original image. The experimental results show that the proposed method is effective in the recognition of low pixel images with both different light conditions and obscured condition.

Author Keywords: Obscured, Low Pixel, Otsu Algorithm, FCCM

articleTitle: Detection of Hierarchical Overlapping Communities in Complex Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: This paper proposes an algorithm for detecting hierarchical overlapping communities in discovering the structure features of complex networks, and visualizing the detecting results with a hierarchical genetic algorithm. Firstly, the detecting algorithm is used to optimize the community structure locally in order to find out the overlapping nodes from the partition which is the result of maximizing the modularity of a complex network. Then a graph which indicates the relationships between communities is built upon the cover of a network. By building the community graph and detecting the community iteratively, the hierarchical overlapping communities of the network which represents the features of a real system is detected.

Author Keywords: Complex Networks, Community Structure, Overlapping Communities Detection, Hierarchical, Modularity.

articleTitle: Series Lead Correction by Root Locus Method
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: The problem of control system calibration is an important branch of the design theory of automatic control system, and is also a practical method to improve the system performance. In this paper, the linear system correction method is studied based on Matlab, focusing on the root trajectory of this correction method in advance correction, through the simulation of visual observation of the role of the correction method. When the performance index of the system is given in the form of time domain, it is generally convenient to use the root locus method for design and correction. The advantage of the root locus correction is that the time domain performance index of the system can be directly estimated based on the distribution of the zero point and the pole of the closed loop on the s-plane.

Author Keywords: root locus, correction, automatic control, lead correction

articleTitle: Machine Learning Based Traffic-Aware Service Reconfiguration in Metropolitan Area Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: With the development of 5G technology and the emergence of the large amount of traffic with various broadband services, the operation and resource scheduling of optical network are facing unprecedented challenges. In the metropolitan area network, the location where users access to the network changes in real time, causing that the tidal traffic in the network changes dynamically with the time. However, the network operators cannot make fast and flexible resource scheduling. Considering tidal traffic in the metropolitan area network, this paper proposes a traffic-aware service reconfiguration algorithm based on machine learning model.

Author Keywords: metropolitan area networks, tidal traffic, machine learning, traffic prediction, service reconfiguration

articleTitle: Controller Placement Optimization Strategy Based on Multi-Objective Bat Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Aiming at the controller placement problem under airborne information network based on logical centralized control, a method named multi-objective bat algorithm based optimal deployment on controllers is proposed(OBA-CP). As targeting the global average delay, the whole network outage probability and the controller load imbalance, an integer programming model of the controller placement under airborne information network based on multi-objective optimization is established. The optimal allocation scheme between transport nodes and controllers in the network is studied by the improved multi-objective bat algorithm for iterative evolution. The simulation results show that the Pareto optimal solution set can be obtained by using the proposed optimization method, so as to realize the reasonable and effective distribution for multiple controllers in the network. Compared with the NCPSO(network clustering particle swarm optimization algorithm) and the SPEA-II(strength pareto evolutionary algorithm-II) algorithm, the OBA-CP algorithm has better network performance in terms of network delay and reliability. It shortens the average computing time, which indicates that the proposed algorithm is suitable for the controller placement problem under airborne information network with the dynamic topology environment.

Author Keywords: airborne information network, controller placement problem, multi-objective optimization, bat algorithm

articleTitle: Research on Voltage Distribution Characteristics of Double-Break Vacuum Circuit Breakers
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Voltage sharing technology of vacuum circuit breaker is the key to popularizing the application of the series-connected breaks. Based on the equivalent circuit of double-break circuit breaker's static voltage distribution, this paper introduced effect of shunt capacitor on double break, and the possibility of parallel voltage sharing resistive-capacitance circuit is analyzed from the attenuation amplitude and oscillation frequency of reburning current oscillation; Parameter requirements of the high voltage break's self-capacitance are analyzed to achieve self-voltage sharing in a typical 40.5kV double-break circuit breaker, and the accuracy is verified by finite element simulation software. The research provides new ideas and methods for the development of multiple break vacuum circuit breakers.

Author Keywords: Vacuum circuit breaker, Double-break, Shunt capacitor, Voltage sharing technology, Resistance-capacitance circuit

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation of Vaporous Hydrogen Peroxide Flow Field for Space Disinfection
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: This paper adopts the method of computational fluid dynamics and computer simulation technology to establish the distribution model of vaporous hydrogen peroxide flow field. The results show that at the injection time of 1200 seconds, the lowest concentration in the hospital operation room reaches 468ppm, which satisfies the disinfection demand. The diffusion law of vapor in the internal space is studied in this paper, which lays a foundation for the vaporous hydrogen peroxide disinfection technology to practical application.

Author Keywords: Numerical Simulation, Vaporous Hydrogen Peroxide, Flow Field, Space Disinfection

articleTitle: A Novel SVD-Based Zero-Watermarking Scheme for Copyright Protection
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In this paper, a novel zero-watermark copyright-protection scheme base on Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) for digital images is proposed, which takes advantage of the essence of SVD, Fuzzy Possibilistic C-Means clustering (FPCM), and image normalization. Image normalization provides robustness against geometric distortions of the host image, and the verification key from the local features are effectively generated by SVD and FPCM. Copyright are then been verified publicly by using digital signature and timestamp. With the verification key, the logo image can be extracted completely without the host image. Compared with relative schemes, the algorithm in the paper is more effective and robust against common image processing and geometric distortions.

Author Keywords: Zero-Watermarking, Singular value decomposition, Digital signature, Copyright protection

articleTitle: A Sparse Matrix Fast Transpose Algorithm Based on Pseudo-Address
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Sparse matrix is a kind of special matrix which is often studied by computer scientists, and computer scientists mainly study its storage structure and algorithm. In this paper, we conceive and design the three-tuple compression storage structure of sparse matrix and the pseudo-address compression storage structure, discuss the transpose algorithm of irregular sparse matrix, mainly study the fast transpose algorithm of sparse matrix, and propose a new matrix transpose algorithm on it for the first time-the sparse matrix fast transpose algorithm of pseudo-address storage structure. It is hoped that this conclusion will provide general algorithm for industrial control and data compression researchers.

Author Keywords: sparse matrix, pseudo-address storage, fast transpose algorithm

articleTitle: Mobile Operation Platform for Power System Maintenance Based on Intelligent Speech Recognition
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of speech recognition in complex operation environment, mobile operation platform for power system maintenance based on intelligent speech recognition which includes power condition maintenance module, operation and maintenance report module, data sharing & business integration module, mobile application management module is proposed. According to the inherent characteristics of artificial speech and background noise, a speech recognition method based on Hidden Markov model (HMM) is adopted to solve the problem of speech recognition in the complex working environment of power system maintenance.

Author Keywords: speech recognition, HMM, mobile

articleTitle: Conversation Extraction over Short Text Stream with Hierarchical LSTM Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Conversation extraction associate topics of utterances in short text stream conversation. The problem of associating topic labels to utterances can be treated as a sequence labeling task. In this work, we build a hierarchical recurrent neural network, using LSTM as the base unit to classify each utterance into its corresponding topic. We apply the results of the DA recognition to the topic classification and define interdependencies in short text stream conversations to improve classification accuracy. Our model achieves state-of-the-art results on two different short text stream conversation datasets.

Author Keywords: Short Text Stream, Conversation Extraction, LSTM

articleTitle: System Outage Probability Performance Analysis Based on Blind Interference Cancelation in Two-Way Relay Network
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Additional self-interference is introduced in two-way relay network (TWRN) while spectral efficiency is increased. As for self-interference problem in amplify-and-forward (AF) modes, a kind of blind interference cancelation (BIC) scheme is employed. The scheme can realize self-interference cancellation and desired signal separation with unknown channel status information by signal precoding operating at transmitting node. In this way, the impact of residual self-interference caused by imperfect channel estimation on TWRN performance is eliminated. Based on this, the closed expression and asymptotic expression of the system outage probability (OP) under M-phase shift keying (MPSK) modulation is derived. Moreover, the influence of SOP performance with channel estimation error under different schemes is analyzed. The correctness of the theoretical derivation is verified by simulation comparison.

Author Keywords: two-way relay network, amplify-and-forward, self-interference cancelation, system outage probalility

articleTitle: Virus Propagation Model and Node Defense Strategy of Single Operation System Virus
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In view of the characteristic of single operation system virus which can only infected the special operation system, the virus propagation mechanism and corresponding node defense strategy is studied. In this paper, taking Windows virus as the research object, the virus propagation model of single operation system virus is constructed based on the SIR model to study the single operation system virus propagation mechanism. to promote network security, the node defense strategies, operation system switching frequency adjustment strategy and operation system scaling strategy, are proposed. The simulation results show that the proposed node defense strategy can effectively inhibit the spread of single operation system virus.

Author Keywords: single operation system virus, SIRL model, virus propagation mechanism, node defense strategy

articleTitle: An Improved Monkey Algorithm with Descending Factor
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Nature inspired meta-heuristics has turn out to be an intimidating and ordinary field of research in the midst of researchers who are trying to solve complex optimization problems. Monkey algorithm is new addition in the class of swarm intelligence, which is a good option for complex optimization problems. This paper puts forward an improved monkey algorithm with descending factor, whose basic idea is that a descending factor is used in the climbing process of the basic monkey algorithm to ensure the algorithm escape from local optimal solution and find the global optimal solution. The proposed algorithm tests over benchmark functions and results show that it receives better results for the considered problems.

Author Keywords: intelligence optimization algorithm, optimization problem, monkey algorithm, descending factor

articleTitle: A Practical Approach to Construct Profile Linkage Framework
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: When the number of social network users increases, the problem of profile linkage is recently enjoying popularity in deeper understanding online users' behaviors. Existing approaches address this issue at the expense of information loss, because they (1) exclude a significant portion of key information, (2) rank users with a lack of consideration on accuracy of profile. In this paper we propose Named-Entity Identity Linkage, a framework for exact social profile linkage. Different from traditional methods, our framework (1) finds out comprehensive information of virtual users by short-text named entity recognition, (2) builds users probabilistic profile library from heterogeneous platforms. Experiments on four popular social network systems show that the method is able to link users of different platforms correctly. It performs about 15% in accuracy and 10% in recall ratio better than state-of-the-art approaches.

Author Keywords: online social network, named entity recognition, profile linkage

articleTitle: The Uncertainty Property on Intelligent Resource Provision in Complex Cloud Environment
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Resource provision is one of the key issues for multiple objective optimizations in cloud data center. This paper emphasizes the fluctuation of workload and investigates the uncertainty property in complex cloud environment especially in software-defined cloud. By leveraging the uncertainty theory, the resource demand value from workload in each dimension is defined as uncertain variable while the uncertain distribution is applied to quantify the variable. The experimental simulation in this paper shows that the uncertain property has great potential in the combinational resource provision.

Author Keywords: resource provision, cloud computing, Intelligence, resource optimization

articleTitle: Chaotic Phenomenon in Permanent-Magnet Synchronous Motor and Its Control Methods
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: This paper analyses chaotic phenomenon in permanent-magnet synchronous machine(PMSM) based on power spectrum and Poincare section. In addition, two chaotic control methods are proposed, which are negative feedback control method and additional periodic signal control method. According to simulation results in Matlab, both of methods are effective. Finally, we discuss their differences. The negative feedback control method cannot only control the original chaotic system to period orbit, but also makes the system at an equilibrium point. The advantage of the additional periodic signal control method is that dynamic properties of the system is not required to identify in advance.

Author Keywords: chaotic phenomenon, negative feedback control, additional periodic signal control, permanent-magnet synchronous machine (PMSM)

articleTitle: Research on Parts Detection System Based on LabVIEW
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: With the rapid development of automated production lines, machine vision inspection has been widely used in parts inspection and target sorting. In this paper, based on LabVIEW machine vision, a part detection system based on automated production line is proposed. First, the calibration of the target detection area, in order to detect the parts in the image more quickly, to track the target of the part, to pre-process the image to reduce the influence of noise, light source and other external environment, in order to obtain the actual part on the production line The coordinate position is used to establish the two-dimensional coordinates and the pixel coordinates are converted to the actual coordinates. The feature of the object is extracted for extracting the contour information of the part, the matching template is set to perform template matching on the part, and the qualified number is displayed on the front panel in real time. Eligibility, pass rate, real-time image acquisition and other data. By selecting different tracking templates and matching templates, this system can quickly trace the target parts and perform template matching to detect those unqualified parts.

Author Keywords: LabVIEW, Machinevision, Template matching, Coordinate construction, Angle calculation

articleTitle: A Physical Layer Authentication Method Based on Exponential Average Data Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Edge computing can achieve faster network service response due to its nearby access characteristics. In the process of massive heterogeneous terminals accessing the network through edge devices, achieving fast and reliable authentication is extremely challenging. The physical layer authentication technology uses channel characteristics for authentication. It is lightweight and can well adapt to the authentication scenario of massive heterogeneous terminal access. The asymmetric resources provided by edge computing are especially suitable for access authentication of physical layer technology. Based on the background of edge computing, this article proposes a physical layer authentication method with exponential average enhancement.

Author Keywords: edge computing, edge devices, physical layer authentication, exponential average enhancement

articleTitle: An Image Processing Platform for Neurovasculature Unit Processed by CLARITY
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: The newly developed CLARITY technique will transfer the whole tissue into hydrogel state by biological and chemical methods to maintain the endogenous fluorescence of tissues. CLARITY has already been used to study the relationship between gray matter atrophy and spinal cord pathology in an experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis model. It is useful for exploring structure of tissues in brain and therefore, understanding its function. However, studies on reconstruction and quantification of tissues images after CLARITY were limited since CLARITY is a new method in this research area. Here the paper developed an image processing platform using a series of images processing algorithm specially for CLARITY. And an experimental and control group is prepared and imaged mouse brain after CLARITY and customized code for this CLARITY are selected. Finally, it visualized the data using Amira and performed quantitative analysis. The customized platform mainly included the preprocessing part, like cutting, histogram matching, brightness adjustment, filtering and morphological operation. The later part was an algorithm specially for different tissues. Results showed that microglia density along depth remained almost unchanged in two groups, microglia diffuses in 2vo group and vessel length and density were the same as the previous study. The conclusions were CLARTY which provided a new tool for studying tissues of mouse brain at high resolution. The analysis platform could offer a powerful tool for further evaluating structural alteration of brain.

Author Keywords: Mouse Brain, CLARITY, Image Process, Neurovascular Unit

articleTitle: Model Based Trajectory Tracking Control of Nonholonomic Mobile Robots
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: A new trajectory tracking control scheme is proposed aiming at the problem of model parameters uncertainty and poor environmental adaptability in non-holonomic mobile robot control. Dynamic characteristics of mobile robots are considered in problem formulation. The control objective is to make the robot move along an expected trajectory with low tracking error while fulfilling its physical constraints. The proposed control scheme is implemented by a combined use of MPC algorithm and grey-box identification. Simulation results show the benefits of the systematic control methodology employed.

Author Keywords: MPC control, grey-box identification, non holonomic mobile robot, trajectory tracking control

articleTitle: Full Constraint Parallel Optimization Algorithm for Structural Optimization of Product Family
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: This paper discusses the problem of structural optimization of product family, and a full constraint parallel optimization (FCPO) algorithm is devised for this problem. The FCPO algorithm decomposes the product family optimization problem into sub-problems, each sub-problem only optimizes the variables of common parts and one product's unique variables, the variables of common parts are kept consistent during the process of optimizing, and the variables of unique parts in other products are fixed as constants, which are equal to the optimal results of the last iteration. The objective of each sub-problem is to minimize all products' weight, and each sub-problem contains the constraints of all products. This paper optimizes a truss family with different algorithms, the result shows that the FCPO algorithm is the most effective algorithm.

Author Keywords: product family, structural optimization, FCPO algorithm

articleTitle: Toward Resilient Median-Based Consensus with Time-Varying Malicious Agents
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: This paper studies the limiting behaviors of a median-based consensus algorithm. Two types of limiting behaviors, cyclic and non-consensus steady states, are investigated for undirected graphs with a focus on regular graphs. We propose a new algorithm to partially solve the two issues, which leads to a resilient consensus algorithm against time-varying malicious agents.

Author Keywords: consensus, median-based algorithm, resilience

articleTitle: Design of Fine Operation and Maintenance Management and Control System of Distribution Equipment Based on Cloud Platform
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: This paper studies the refined operation and maintenance management of distribution grid equipment from the current situation and management methods. Starting from the positioning and business requirement analysis of the cloud-based intelligent operation and maintenance management platform for distribution grid equipment, this paper discusses the functions of equipment operation status management, operation and maintenance management and its KPI management, mobile operation and maintenance behavior management, as well as the business management content and information presentation form of each sub-module. The purpose is to support intelligent decision-making for the scientific planning of distribution grid, for accurate construction, for efficient operation inspection, and lean management ensures safe, reliable and economic operation of distribution grid, and provides better and convenient power supply and service. The research results have been applied to the construction of operation, maintenance and control of distribution grid in Guangzhou Baiyun Power Supply Company of CSG, and can provide reference for the design of big data application scenarios.

Author Keywords: distribution grid, refined operation and maintenance management, operation status

articleTitle: TagNet: Tag Out the Value Sequence of SQL Statement
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In order to assist person who doesn't know how to write SQL to access the data in a relation database, using a deep neural architecture to translate the natural language to SQL has recently been extensively studied. Previous work suffers from the complexity of where clause, since the number of conditions is totally random and predicting the value of condition is a sequence-to-sequence problem. We follow the slot filling idea, and introduce a model called TagNet. First of all, we innovatively propose a task attention mechanism. It takes the relativity of tasks into consideration for attention mechanism. Secondly, we use type embedding of each token of question and each column to enhance the representation for value prediction. Thirdly, in the task of predicting WHERE VALUE, we propose a tag decoder. It output a sequence of equal length compared with input. It consists of two tokens:<;QUE>, <;VAL>, indicating the corresponding token of input is whether or not a value token. We evaluate out model on WikiSQL, and compared to our baseline-SQLNet, we gain an absolute 7.6% increase on logic form accuracy and 6.3% increase on execution accuracy.

Author Keywords: natural language to SQL, TagNet, task attention, tag decoder

articleTitle: Agility Measurement of Agile Supply Chain Network Based on Complex Network Theory
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: With the development of information technology, the supply chain has developed into a new stage of intelligent supply chain which is deeply integrated with the Internet and the Internet of Objects. In order to give full play to the characteristics of innovation, collaboration, win-win, openness and greenness in supply chain, and to build a smart supply chain system with big data support, network sharing and intelligent collaboration, the agility measurement of supply chain has become an urgent and important topic. This paper presents an agile metric based on complex network theory for agile supply chain network. Firstly, the mathematical expression of agile supply chain network and its agility measurement method are defined, and the constraints of complex network theory are also defined. Secondly, to facilitate the calculation of agility metrics, complex network theory is introduced into agile supply chain network. In addition, a large number of experiments have been designed and implemented to verify the accuracy of the proposed complex network theory in agile supply chain network measurement. At the same time, the agility of the supply chain network is measured, and its changing rules and optimization methods are summarized. The experimental results show that the proposed complex network theory can accurately measure the agility of agile supply chain network. The purpose of this paper is to provide a method to turn agile supply chain system into intelligent information system through mathematical modeling.

Author Keywords: complex network theory, agile supply chain network, estimated value, agility measurement, intelligent information system

articleTitle: Research on Control Flow Integrity Scheme for Android Platform
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Although there are protection mechanisms like ASLR, DEP, SELinux in the Android system, they are not very effective. Although the control flow integrity scheme already has multiple schemes, some of them are protected at the source code level, some are protected by binary files, and the protection of binary files requires a large scope to rewrite binary files. This paper breaks through the difficulty of binary file rewriting, and innovatively proposes a control flow integrity protection scheme for binary files already existed in the Android system, which can effectively protect heap overflow in the Android system with a small amount of modification to binary. Attacks such as memory uninitialization, re-use after release, double release, and other memory-destroyed vulnerabilities.

Author Keywords: Android, Control Flow, Integrity, ShellCode

articleTitle: Network Security Situational Assessment Method Based on Historical Situations
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Resulting from the existing network security situational assessment approaches do not consider the correlation and compariation between different situations of the same network, a network security situaltional assessment method based on historical situaltions is proposed. By establishing the assessment index system and the threat order preference model by similarity to ideal solution, the threat order between current situation and historical ones can be established. Therefore, the current threat level is found out by using the existing historical threats as references. The result of an experiment shows that the approach is able to establish the threat order accurately. Then, the current network situation and its trend of development can be found out accurately.

Author Keywords: situational assessment, historical situations, assessment index system, technique for order preference by similarity to ideal solution

articleTitle: Design of a Kind of Automatic Granulation Equipment with Mixed Chemicals
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of manual extrusion with scraper on the granulation network, such as high labor intensity, low production efficiency, bad production environment and low production safety, a set of equipment for automatic granulation of silicon mixture was developed. The main technical requirements, mechanical system design and composition of the equipment are introduced, and the electrical control design is expounded. The results show that the design can realize the automatic granulation of a silicon-based mixture, and the production efficiency is high. The design has been successfully applied to the production of a certain enterprise.

Author Keywords: automatic, PLC, granulation, servo drive

articleTitle: Evaluate Software Quality by Learning from Historical Data
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: This paper proposes a method to evaluate software quality by learning from historical data. Quantitative evaluation of software quality is not an easy issue. But historical software can provide us with a lot of software quality information. We present a data acquiring model to guide the data collection from historical software. Then machine learning algorithm that support incremental training is applied to learn the relationship between software quality and software metrics from the data. As a case study, we collected the data of 82 aviation embedded software in an institute, and trained a k-Nearest Neighbors (k-NN) classification model optimized by genetic algorithms for evaluating the software reliability.

Author Keywords: Software quality, software reliability, software metrics, quality evaluation, machine learning, k-Nearest Neighbors (k-NN), genetic algorithms (GA)

articleTitle: Task-Oriented Service Allocation in Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: This paper focuses on the problem that how to allocate service instances in cloud to execute tasks, so that reduce the communication overhead in the cloud as much as possible. First, we formulate the Task-oriented Service Selected Problem (TSSP). To study the complexity of the problem, we reduce the set cover problem to an instance of TSSP when all hosts for the service instances connected to the same switch. Therefore we propose the algorithm of TSSA for this case. Furthermore, we propose the algorithm for the case that all hosts for the service instances go beyond the same switch. Finally, the simulation results show the effectiveness of our algorithms.

Author Keywords: Service Allocation, Task Oriented, Cloud Computing

articleTitle: An Improved MCVideo System Video Stream Adaptive Control Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: When the number of video group call users increases dramatically, existing TEAR algorithm cannot adjust congestion windows in time, causing network congestion, and its congestion window control does not meet the MCVideo system control level requirements. Aiming to solve the uncertainty about the number of users of MCVideo system video group calls, the paper proposes an adaptive MCVideo system video stream congestion window control algorithm. This algorithm uses an additive logarithmic growth factor in the congestion avoidance phase to control the congestion window of the video stream, thereby automatically adjusting the congestion window of the video stream according to the number of users to avoid network congestion. Theoretical analysis and experimental results show that the algorithm has higher throughput and lower packet loss rates than the TEAR algorithm.

Author Keywords: MCVideo system, Congestion control, Amount of users, TEAR algorithm, Adaptive adjustment, Additive factor, Throughput, Packet loss rates.

articleTitle: Code Confusion Confrontation Method Based on Feature Comparison
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: With the maturity of code hardening technology, more and more malicious applications have adopted the reinforcement technology to avoid the detection of anti-virus engines, which brings great challenges for the identification and analysis of malicious code. The paper through an in-depth analysis of common detection avoidance techniques, the technical principle of reinforcement is studied, and a code confusion countermeasure method based on feature comparison is constructed. The method takes the unobfuscated function in the target application as a reference, extracts the target application characteristics by constructing the dependency graph of the program code, and then performs code similarity query in the software gene library system constructed in this paper, and analyzes based on the query result. The code segment is similar or identical to the obfuscated code, and finally restores the confusing variable or string name based on the variable mapping relationship before and after the confusion, thereby achieving effective recovery of the obfuscated code.

Author Keywords: Android, malicious code, Code obfuscation, dependency graph

articleTitle: Cross-Domain Secure Sharing of Video Based on White-Box Encryption
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In the vertical multi-level public network, the ciphertext video needs to support the distribution of key in the whole network when it is shared across different security domains horizontally. However, the traditional key management mode faces great pressure on the security classification and encryption efficiency, and especially, it cannot fully ensure the security of content and key when sharing across-domains. Based on the above analysis, this paper proposes a cross domain video security sharing solution based on white box encryption theory to improve the security of video data sharing. In this solution, the white box encryption technology is adopted to establish the data sharing background trust mechanism based on the key management center, and we study the white box key protection technology of the video terminal to support the mass level key distribution in the network and the online security generation and replacement of the white box password module, so that the safe and fast cross domain exchange and sharing of video data are realized.

Author Keywords: Key management, encrypted video, security grading, white-box cryptography theory, secure sharing

articleTitle: A Practical Path Planning Method in Aircraft Assembly Process Simulation
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: This paper proposes a method of solving aircraft assembly path planning by sampling search and implemented this method in virtual assembly application. This paper analyzes the advantages of two different sampling search methods, and finally selects the tree sampling search method. The Bullet physics engine is employed to implement obstacle detection. Finally, in the software platform, the simulation of the assembly process is completed based on the OpenSceneGraph visualization engine.

Author Keywords: virtual assembly, motion planning, obstacle detection

articleTitle: Resource Deployment in Data Communication Intensive Cloud Environment
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In data communication intensive cloud environment, the number of communication hops is usually few. Hence the congestion cannot be avoided by rerouting. Therefore, when some large data streams occupy communication resources, other applications may have excessive delay, resulting in violation of QoS. In this paper, we propose a data communication intensive cloud environment resource architecture. We both consider the deployment of virtual machines on physical hosts, and the deployment of services on virtual machines. For virtual machine deployment, we formally define the problem and propose a knapsack-based heuristic algorithm. The algorithm makes full use of the physical machine capacity to reduce the communication overhead. Taking the idea of virtual machine deployment and considering the characteristics of service deployment, a service deployment algorithm is proposed. Finally, we verify the effectiveness of our approach through simulation experiments.

Author Keywords: Cloud Environment, Virtual Machine Deployment, Service Deployment

articleTitle: A Detection and Alarm Algorithm against the Third-Party Excavation
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: It often happens that the third-party excavation damage to underground pipelines in cities. A detection and alarm algorithm to prevent the third-party construction excavation is proposed in order to give early warning for the damage of the third-party excavation. Through the construction of excavation signal database, the time-frequency joint feature vectors of different types of excavation signals are extracted, and the machine learning classification model of excavation signals is constructed with the idea of deep learning to predict and classify common types of the third-party excavation signals, so as to capture and monitor the third-party excavation signals in real time. Once the excavation event is detected to be happening, remote alarm will be carried out to realize the early warning of underground pipeline excavation damage, and then the safe operation of underground pipelines is effectively guaranteed.

Author Keywords: machine learning, signal classification, under ground pipeline, third-party Excavation

articleTitle: Research on Traffic Flow Time Series Model and Shortest Path Algorithm of Urban Traffic Based on Travel Plans
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: The Development and popularization of the vehicle navigation technology, automatic driving technology, GPS technology and big data technology, provide conditions for the transparency and sharing of traffic data in the future. Meanwhile, the innovation of the 5G technology and cloud computing also create conditions for the calculation of massive data. To effectively alleviate traffic congestion in modern cities, the authors proposed a traffic flow time series model and shortest path algorithm of urban traffic based on travel plans. Travel plans, namely, are the information about users' planning travel, including the starting point, destination, departure time, etc. Adopting lots of users' travel plans as the main source data, the authors constructed a traffic flow time series model with dynamic future traffic flow. Based on this model, the improved Floyd algorithm was used to calculate the shortest path. After the shortest path is adopted by users, update the traffic flow time series model to obtain more accurate future traffic flow data. Travel plans have the characteristics of real-time and reliability, the traffic flow data based on real-time travel plans is more realistic than the traditional traffic flow prediction methods which are based on historical data. Likewise, the optimal path algorithm based on the traffic flow time series model is also more scientific than the traditional optimal path algorithms theoretically.

Author Keywords: travel plan
shortest path, time series model, vehicle navigation, intelligent transportation, automatic driving

articleTitle: Fault Tolerant Algorithm for MMC-Based Shore Power Supply System
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: This paper presents a falult tolerant algorithm and a novel start-up Scheme for MMC-based shore power supply system(SPSS) that consists of rectifier and inverter. In the whole start-up stage, all the additional circuit are not to be required. Through the coordination between Rectifier and Inverter that are operated in nearest level control modulation, SPSS is started with small impulse current. The proposed scheme ensure the normal opration of the equipment when one cell (at most two cells) fault condition occurs in the operation. To verify the feasibility of the scheme, a 10MVA/10kV MMC-based back-to-back model is established in MATLAB that uses S-function, and in which two cells fault condition is emulated. Simulation results verify its effectiveness.

Author Keywords: shore power supply system, start-up, fault tolerant, modular multilevel(MMC), Nearest level control(NLC).

articleTitle: Research on Equipment Support Evaluation Method Based on Wavelet Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: To evaluate the equipment support level scientifically and reasonablely, a Wavelet Neural Network (WNN) evaluation method of equipment support is proposed. In the method, firstly, on the basis of system analysis, the evaluation index system of equipment support is constructed. Then WNN model is established, and the equipment support is evaluated by built model. The simulation result verifies its feasibility and effectiveness.

Author Keywords: Wavelet, Neural network, Equipment support, Evaluation

articleTitle: Research and Design of Grinding Equipment for Wind Turbine Blades Closing Root
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: The paper mainly analyzed and studied the grinding equipment for the root closing mold of 68.6 wind turbine blades. The grinding mechanism was designed and tested according to the shape, size and field working conditions of wind turbine blades. Through analysis and calculation, the straight-line walking scheme was obtained to ensure the rationality of the structure. Base on analyses of grinding theory, the grinding wheel which affects the grinding surface accuracy was analyzed. Finally, its size was determined by testing. The research and design of equipment would improve the efficiency of wind turbine blade production, and produce enormous economic and social benefits.

Author Keywords: Wind Turbine Blades, Root closing Mold, Grinding

articleTitle: A Blind Positioning Method for Sound Signal Source
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: With the development of silicon microphone technology, high-precision spatial positioning of sound sources becomes possible. When the sound source position of its near-field and far-field models is known, three-dimensional positioning is relatively easy. However, it is difficult to predict the range of the near-field and far-field of the source, which brings difficulties to the subsequent algorithm processing. In addition, the reflection and noise of the sound source signal, reverberation and the phase inconsistency of the silicon microphone also affect. In order to solve these problems, this paper proposes a fusion localization method, and optimized through software tools. The simulation results show that the algorithm is better than the traditional algorithm. The error has been reduced by more than three times. In the far-field model, the influence of the amplitude is eliminated by generalization, thereby optimizing its positioning accuracy. The stability of the positioning is increased by covariance calculation in the near-field model. By comparing the variances of the two models for the calculation of the same sound source, the calculation method with smaller error is selected to determine the model, and the final sound location. Simulations demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method. Then the five-sensor cross microphone array is used to verify the experimental results. The experimental results show that the method can effectively improve the positioning accuracy of blind sound sources and has high practical value.

Author Keywords: blind source localization, five-sensor cross array, Generalization, adaptive far-near field

articleTitle: 3D Scene Modeling and Rendering Algorithm Based on River Extraction of Remote Sensing Image
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of modeling and rendering of large data scene, this paper presents a fast method for modeling and rendering multi-level, multi-resolution river based on the river information extraction of simple attribute remote sensing image. Firstly, Fuzzy C-means Clustering (FCM), Support Vector Machine(SVM) and Markov Random Field (MRF) river extraction methods are used to extract the river skeleton information and river center control points of satellite remote sensing images. Then, the cubic B-spline curve function is used to fit the control information of the river center into the central line of the river. Finally, according to the terrain resolution levels, the river model will be rebuilt, which is rendered at multiple levels through the terrain resolution by modifying the terrain data to achieve the effect of long-distance fuzzy and close-distance clearness. Experiments show that this method can realize the modeling and rendering of large data scenes effectively and vividly.

Author Keywords: remote sensing image, river extraction, multi resolution terrain, modeling rendering

articleTitle: An Improved MCPTT System File Breakpoint Resuming Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: For the time-varying channel quality of MCPTT system, in order to successfully transmit large multimedia files, an improved file breakpoint retransmission algorithm in MCPTT system is proposed. By jointly considering the user channel quality and file size, adaptively fragments large multimedia files and selects the appropriate number of retransmissions, which can improve the transmission success rate and transmission rate of large multimedia files. Theoretical analysis and simulation results show that compared with the traditional breakpoint resuming algorithm, the algorithm can not only improve the transmission success rate, but also reduce the file transmission time of large multimedia files.

Author Keywords: Session Initiation Protocol, Message Session Relay Protoco1, file fragmentation, retransmission times

articleTitle: Study on Teaching Mode Selection Model Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: the selection of teaching mode is related to the improvement of teaching quality. In order to improve the quality of teaching and promote the transformation of teaching results, combined with big data statistical analysis method, a choosing teaching method is proposed based on big data's analysis, which constructs the statistical analysis model of teaching mode selection by descriptive statistical analysis method, and extracts the quantity of characteristic information that reflects the optimization of teaching method selection. The big data analysis model based on fuzzy C-means clustering is used to evaluate the performance of teaching methods, and the method of segmental sample detection is used to carry out regression analysis to realize the sample fitting of teaching method selection. The mathematical model of teaching mode selection is designed through the sample fitting result, and the statistical mathematical model based on big data's teaching mode selection is constructed. The simulation results show that the method is used to select the teaching method; it can effectively extract the regular characteristic quantity, which reflects the teaching performance, realizes the association rule mining of the choice of teaching method. The teaching mode is selected according to the result of big data mining and statistical analysis, improving the teaching quality, and promoting the reform of teaching methods.

Author Keywords: big data, teaching mode selection, mathematical model, Statistical analysis, feature extraction, regression analysis

articleTitle: A Nonlinear Control Method for Asymmetric Hydraulic Cylinder Based on Incremental Digital Valve Control
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In this paper, an output feedback nonlinear control is proposed for an asymmetric hydraulic cylinder based on incremental digital valve control system with unmodeled disturbances and parametric uncertainties. It's composed of a high gain state observer (HGO) and a dynamic surface sliding mode controller. The high gain state observer is designed to estimate the unmeasured system states. The dynamic surface sliding mode controller is designed to stabilize the closed-loop system. The proposed controller accounts for not only the unmodeled disturbances, but also the parametric uncertainties. In theory, the controller guarantees a prescribed tracking transient performance and final tracking accuracy even in the presence of unmodeled disturbances and parametric uncertainties. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified via simulation.

Author Keywords: incremental digital valve, high gain state observer, dynamic surface sliding mode controller, disturbances and parametric uncertainties

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Translation System Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Based on the new generation of artificial intelligence theory, such as deep learning, this paper proposed an intelligent translation model based on bidirectional long short-term memory model and attention mechanism. By training deep recurrent neural network, the encoder-decoder framework significantly improves the translation accuracy and system stability, and significantly reduces the training time compared with the traditional statistical machine translation model. Meanwhile, it will also improve the robustness of the intelligent translation system and solve problems such as the lack of training corpus for small language.

Author Keywords: intelligent translation, deep learning, long short term memory, attention mechanism

articleTitle: The Application of Image Recognition Technology in Testing Impact Strength of Epoxy Resin Composites
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In this paper, the SEM image of epoxy resin composite material section was analyzed by the image recognition technology. The number of the textures and spots of the SEM image were found and calculated. By coupling the two data, the influencing factors of the impact strength of epoxy resin composites were judged quickly. This method is more helpful to obtain the section image information in a short time and contrast the impact strength of composite materials more effectively.

Author Keywords: Image recognition, Epoxy resin, Impact strength, SEM figure

articleTitle: Automatic Clustering and Visualization of Linked Data through Embedding Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Linked data becomes an important information with the development of the internet. The appropriate visualization of these kind of data allows user to understanding it. However, the position information of elements in the linked data is often unknown. This makes low-dimensional visualization of the linked data challenging. This paper proposes an embedding-learning approach to automatically learn the high-dimensional vector representation of each element using machine-learning technology. The learned vectors are then reduced to two-dimensional vectors using Stochastic Neighbor Embedding (SNE) algorithm for 2D-visualization. The visualization results on the MovieLens dataset demonstrates that the proposed embedding-learning method can automatically learn the high-dimensional representation and the clustering structure of linked data, making the linked data more understandable.

Author Keywords: Linked Data, Visualization, Embedding Learning, Stochastic Neighbor Embedding algorithm

articleTitle: Simulations for Single Event Transient Effects in the LM124 Operational Amplifier
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Single event transient effect in LM124 Operational Amplifier is investigated in this paper by computer simulations. Circuit level simulations are performed to analyze the output response of a voltage follower which consists of LM124 Operational Amplifier under single event transients (SETs). Simulation results show that different output responses were shown in different parts under the radiation. Furthermore, the most sensitive parts under the SETs are found. Simulations results above are helpful for further harden designs of linear ICs.

Author Keywords: radiation, operational amplifier, single event transient effect, circuit simulation, bipolar transistor

articleTitle: A Novel Controllable Image Segmentation Method Using the Inverse GAMMA Distribution Function Based on Histogram Specification
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Image segmentation(IMSEG) is defined as a top of the basic and most significant process of digital image handling which refers to the techniques that used to partitioning and dividing an image into useful and meaningful parts, called segments. It's so important for many applications which difficult and inefficient to process the entire image, such as object recognition or image compression. So, IMSEG aims to segment the image into districts for further operations and processing. There are several techniques for image segmentation which divide the image into many parts regarding to some specific image properties such as the intensity value of pixels, relation between pixels, color, texture and so on. However, most image segmentation techniques have deficient ability to plainly tune the segment sensitivity of the segmented image. In our manuscript we will propose a new technique for image segmentations using the invers GAMMA distribution function based on histogram matching, the proposed technique provides a method to manage the segment sensitivity of segmented image via setting one parameter. Experimental outcomes pretend a superior execution of this created technique.

Author Keywords: Image Segmentation, GAMMA distribution

articleTitle: Research on Detection and Warning of Air Threat Situation for UAV Collision Avoidance
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In order to provide the early warning for UAV flight collision avoidance according to air threat situation, a detection and warning method of air threat situation is proposed for UAV flight collision avoidance. In the method, firstly, the track of the intruder is dynamically predicted by a prediction method. Then, using the predicted track and the flight information of UAV and intruder, the dynamic collision avoidance zone of UAV is established to the intruder. Finally, the detection and warning for flight collision trend between UAV and intruder is carried out in a specific flight scenario. Simulation show that the proposed method is effective and the feasible.

Author Keywords: UAV, Collision avoidance, Threat situation, Detection, Early warning

articleTitle: Image Scaling Algorithm Based on Elliptic Curve
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: When Digital Video image transformation from general screen (i.e., 4:3, etc.) to widescreen (i.e., 16:9, etc.), the length-width ratio of source image will change. So, it is difficult to adjust image resolution and convert the format. In this paper, a method of nonlinear scaling is proposed, aiming at overcoming the image distortion problems caused by conventional transform methods. The proposed method is that the vertical direction is transformed by linear interpolation, and nonlinear scaling transformation is conducted in the horizontal direction. The elliptic curve scaling function is used on both sides of the image and appropriate linear scaling factor is added in the central area, achieving the overall image of the nonlinear scaling factor change continuously. It can greatly reduce the image distortion in human vision. The simulation result shows that the distortion of the scaled image is acceptable, the proposed method is more efficient than conventional methods.

Author Keywords: nonlinear scaling, scaling curve, elliptic curve function, nonlinear scaling factor

articleTitle: Integrated Control and Processing Technology of Multiple Signals for Batch Power Sensors
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Data fusion is a process of combining information from different sources, different modes, different media, different times and different representations, and finally getting a more accurate description of the perceived object.
