Through the reasonable control and use of multi-sensor and its observation information, according to the set criteria, the parallel data can be combined quickly to obtain the consistent interpretation or description of the tested object. Multi-sensor information processing can be divided into two situations: one is the side device with multiple detection quantities and the other is the side device with multiple detection quantities. In view of these two application scenarios, this paper proposes an efficient and fast data processing method and a processing method to increase the classification of container technology to process different source data, and uses time-division multiplexing technology to transmit different levels of data streams in time slots, which improves the number. The timeliness of the evidence. The research results of this paper provide an effective theoretical and experimental basis for sensor data processing and control system of ubiquitous Internet of things.

Author Keywords: distribution network, distribution, flow processing, multi-source

articleTitle: A Sector Combination Optimization Algorithm for the Multi-Depot Vehicle Routing Problem
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: This paper proposes a bilevel programming method to solve the MDVRP problem, the goal is to minimize the vehicle distribution distance. On the premise of meeting the capacity of the yard and the demand of customers, the upper layer assigns customers to the depots according to the nearest distance from the depot. The lower level solves the problem of single vehicle route planning respectively, assigning customers to vehicles and planning their access sequence. In the lower level, the sector combination optimization (SCO) algorithm is used to generate multiple initial solutions. With these solutions as the initial population of genetic algorithm and ant colony algorithm, the number of iterations can be reduced to achieve fast convergence. And because of the abundant initial solutions, the algorithm can avoid trapping in local optimum. The results show that the sector combination optimization algorithm makes the initial solutions more abundant while reducing the space of the problem.

Author Keywords: equipment maintenance support, the sector combination optimization algorithm, the merge - head and drop - tail strategy, the multi depot vehicle routing problem

articleTitle: Fully Convolutional Network for Object Direction Estimation in the Wild
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In recent years, object detection has been widely applied in various fields, such as aircraft navigation, and power line inspection. However, the object pose estimation in complex background still remains challenging. In this paper, an end-to-end object direction regression system based on the fully convolutional network is proposed. The system can learn deep features from data and use convolutional layers to regress the direction angle of the object. The experiments show that this method can accurately estimate the direction angle of the object from the image.

Author Keywords: direction estimation, fully convolutional network, insulator strings

articleTitle: A Unidimension Histogram Grid Algorithm for ISV Real Time Obstacle Avoidance
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: With the development of the ocean going intelligent surface vessel (ISV), a real-time collision avoidance system is required to guarantee the safety navigation in the practical marine engineering. In this paper, a unidimension histogram grid collision avoidance method for obstacle avoidance based on the binocular stereo vision technology is proposed. The advantages of the proposed method could map the ISV collision avoidance problem from high dimension space to low dimension space, and achieve the main collision avoidance space eigenvalues axis to collision avoidance solutions. Furthermore, the characteristics of low calculation consumption and not required accurate image depth information are also prominent. Finally the validity and superior collision avoidance performance of the proposed method is demonstrated through the smart ISV experiment.

Author Keywords: imension histogram, binocular stereo vision

articleTitle: Scheme of Civil Aircraft Maintenance Management Internal Audit Based on Quality Function Deployment
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: This paper aims to decompose and deploy the internal audit of civil aircraft maintenance organization using the method of quality function deployment. And we analyze the components, scope and methods of the internal audit from the aspect of system and method establishment. Finally, the key points of internal audit scheme are identified systematically.

Author Keywords: aircraft maintenance, quality function deployment, internal audit

articleTitle: Periodically Intermittent Synchronization of Discontinuous NNs with Time-Varying Delays
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: This paper investigates the synchronization problem of discontinuous neural networks(NNS) with time-varying delays via periodically intermittent control. Based on the piecewise Lyapunov functional and linear matrix inequality (LMI) technique, the synchronization criteria for discontinuous NNs are derived. Also, the control gains of the periodically intermittent control are given in terms of LMIs. Numerical simulations are presented to illustrate the effectiveness of our theoretical results.

Author Keywords: Synchronization, discontinuous neural networks, periodically intermittent control, linear matrix inequalities(LMI)

articleTitle: Semantic Image Inpainting Based on Autoencoding Adversarial Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Image inpainting is one of the most challengeable tasks in computer vision study. Methods based on image statics of unmasked area generally produce smooth results, but has no semantics understanding of the images. Methods based on deep learning technic have semantics understanding of images, but obtain results with blurred inpainting content. We propose an inpainting network based on autoencoding networks to repair masked images semantically with a combination of encoder-decoder network and mix-discriminators in this study. The mix-discriminators are composed of a global and a local discriminator to judge whether the results are completed or not. In detail, we train an encoder network to learn and extract hidden representations from the input images, and a decoder network to predict the contents of the masked areas based on the hidden representations. Then the outputs and the original images are fed to a global discriminator for judging the consistency of whole output images and a local discriminator for supervising the authenticity of the inpainting areas. The two discriminators will propaganda back a gradient to train the inpainting network to produce realistic image contents.

Author Keywords: Image Inpainting, Deep Learning, Encoder-Decoder

articleTitle: Traveling Wave Fault Location System Based on IEC 61850 with False Alarms Elimination
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: The proposal of data model of IEC 61850 makes it possible to establish a new type of traveling wave fault location master system. Under this background, traveling wave fault location master station system compatible with different types of traveling wave ranging devices is established, and the false alarms elimination function is developed by obtaining the switch action and other information through the traditional power grid automation system.

Author Keywords: traveling wave ranging master station, IEC 61850, intelligent screening

articleTitle: Vector Quantization for Large Scale CBIR
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In order to meet the requirements of image retrieval and real-time index storage of massive datasets, a Content-based Image Retrieval (CBIR) based on vector quantization is used in this paper. By the feature extraction of depth residual network, the improved Product Quantization (PQ) coding algorithm is used to generate index and dynamic database under FAISS Framework, which can realize nonlinear large-scale CBIR with high robustness. Empirical results show that the CBIR based on improved PQ has achieved good performance in index compression rate, recall rate and retrieval time compared with PQ and Locality-Sensitive Hashing (LSH) in SIFT1M dataset.

Author Keywords: content-based image retrieval, product quantization, dynamic index database

articleTitle: Maximum Likelihood Function Indoor Positioning Algorithm Based on RSSD
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: At present, the research of indoor positioning is mainly based on active positioning, which means the transmitting node to be located can interact with the receiver. In this case, a higher positioning accuracy has been achieved. But in some cases, the power of the transmitter is unknown, which requires the study of passive positioning. Therefore, this paper proposes a maximum likelihood function method based on received signal strength difference (RSSD), which solves the problem that the source power is unknown power and reduces the complexity of the algorithm. The algorithm is tested in the laboratory with a length of 10.111m and a width of 6.129m. The test result shows that the positioning error is 1.2m when the CDF is less than 50%, and it is 2.09m when the CDF is less than 90%. Compared with the maximum likelihood function method based on received signal strength indicator (RSSI), the positioning accuracy of the algorithm is improved by 5% and the calculation amount of the algorithm is reduced by 70%.

Author Keywords: Indoor Positioning, Maximum Likelihood, Received Signal Strength Difference

articleTitle: Influence Factors Analysis of Distribution Transformer Fault Using Cox Proportional Hazard Model
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Due to the impact of bad weather, overload, and three-phase unbalance, the distribution transformer may have a fault. The fault of the distribution transformer brings economic losses. Thus, it is necessary to carry out fault analysis of the distribution transformer. In this paper, the Cox proportional hazard model has been used to analyze the influence factors of the distribution transformer fault. Five indexes have been defined. The scores of the indexes have been calculated by using the negative point method and used as covariates in the Cox proportional hazard model. The weekly and monthly data have been used and compared. Results show that the load rate and the degree of current unbalance have a significant influence on the distribution transformer fault. The results of weekly and monthly data are consistent.

Author Keywords: distribution transformer, fault, influence factor, Cox PHM, negative point

articleTitle: Research on the Flexibility of Carrier - Based Aircraft Equipment System Based on Complex Network Theory
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: When a carrier-based aircraft equipment system based on a mission is in operation, a complex network is composed of reconnaissance and warning systems, command and control systems, fire strike systems, information countermeasures systems, combat evaluation system and integrated safeguard systems. From the view of complex network to analyze the carrier aircraft equipment system, the authors can find flexible features in the system in operation. This is of great significance for the analysis of combat effectiveness of the carrier-based aircraft equipment system.

Author Keywords: component, Carrier-based Aircraft Equipment System, Complex Network Theory, Flexibility

articleTitle: Change Detection from Molti-Band Remote Sensing Image Based on Spectral Product Fusion and MRF Model
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Traditional remote sensing image change detection methods are difficult to detect complete change information by incomplete bands information, and change detection accuracy is not guaranteed. To solve this problem, the paper propose multi-band remote sensing image change detection method by spectral fusion and Markov Random Field. In the method, the difference image and ratio image are fused by spectral product fusion model, and get fusion image, all bands change information are used by iterative calculation, and obtain optimal change information. Experimental results show that the detection accuracy of the proposed method is superior to the current change detection methods, and good stability.

Author Keywords: change detection, spectral fusion, MRF model, iterative calculation

articleTitle: Fractal-Scaling Non-Parametric Processing of Spatial-Temporal Flow of Real Polarimetric Information in the Radio Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: The results of the digital fractal-scaling processing using the set of real radar images (RRI) received by the radar at the 2 m wave length are presented.

Author Keywords: fractal, radar, target detection, detector, fractal spatio temporal processing, nonparametric statistics

articleTitle: A Modified MOEAD with an Adaptive Weight Adjustment Strategy
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Multiobjective evolutionary algorithm based on decomposition (MOEA/D) is widely used to dispose multiobjective optimization problems (MOPs). The performance of MOEA/D is not ideal when deals with MOPs which are with degenerated curve. Aiming to this weakness, an adaptive weight adjustment strategy named BPO is proposed in this paper. In order to solve this problem, BPO strategy is based on the number of reference points referencing the archive. The results of tests show that MOEA/D with BPO strategy can obtain ideal performance. MOEA/D with BPO strategy can improves the weakness of MOEA/D effectively on MOPs which are with degenerated curve.

Author Keywords: multiobjective, decomposition, evolutionary, optimization, adaptive

articleTitle: Research on Abnormal Data Mining Technology in Military Network Communication Data
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In order to ensure the accuracy of data transmission in military network communication and improve the capability of intelligent fault analysis of military network communication, abnormal data mining is needed. An anomaly data mining model in military network communication is proposed based on simplified gradient algorithm and autocorrelation feature matching. Firstly, the military network communication system model is constructed, and the information flow model is constructed and the abnormal data feature extraction is carried out. The matched filter is used to filter the abnormal data in the military network communication data, and several known interference frequency components are removed. The matching projection method is used to find the optimized characteristic solution of the abnormal data mining. The simplified gradient algorithm is used for adaptive optimization of abnormal data mining, and the autocorrelation feature matching method is used to extract the abnormal data from military network communication data. The simulation results show that, this method is used to mine abnormal data in military network communication data, and it has good accuracy and strong anti-jamming ability.

Author Keywords: military network communication, data mining, filtering, anti-jamming

articleTitle: Quantum Algorithm for Finding Sets Intersection
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: We propose a quantum algorithm to solve the intersection problem of two sets by extending Bernstein-Vazirani algorithm. Given set and set . In the classic algorithm, we need to query times to find the solution of set . However, in our quantum algorithm, we need only one quantum query to find the set .

Author Keywords: quantum algorithm, set intersection, quantum circuit

articleTitle: Application of Fractional Calculus for Impact Oscillator Modeling
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: A new theoretical model for describing an impact oscillator that is based on the use of a fractional derivative is constructed. The acoustic signals that occur when the probe strikes the surface of metals are experimentally investigated. It is shown that acoustic signals can be used to diagnose elastic properties of materials.

Author Keywords: fractional calculus, impact oscillator, damped vibrations, energy dissipation, mathematical modeling, natural experiment

articleTitle: An Approach to Data Flow Optimization for False Invoice Emergency Management on Cloud
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: As the cloud computing has become popular, there is a tendency to develop the service-oriented workflow on cloud. On false invoice emergency management, service-oriented workflow on cloud is a good choice. However, during the workflow execution, large amounts of intermediate data need be stored effectively, otherwise causing unnecessary data transfers, so that become a bottleneck to performance. In this paper, a data scheduling strategy is proposed, which offers additional efficiencies by allowing services of workflow to execution with less data transfers by scheduling the data among data centers based on the data collaboration relations. Our data scheduling strategy not only makes the data transfer time reduced obviously, but also makes the running cost of data scheduling reduced obviously. Simulations demonstrate that the new architecture brings about at least 65% and 47% improvements than existing architecture in process execution time and throughput.

Author Keywords: data flow, cloud computing, service-oriented workflow, data schedule, data collaboration relation

articleTitle: An Intelligent Solution to In-Home Power Line Communication
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: This paper provides an intelligent solution to power line communication (PLC) by applying deep learning (DL) to the transmission system of PLC. To this end, we choose low voltage (LV) power line as a study case. Based on the channel measurement campaign on residential LV distribution areas in Ganzhou city, Jiangxi province, China, the in-home PLC channel is modeled as a multi-path channel. As for the noise model, we adopt the additive Middleton Class-A noise (AWCN) composed of impulsive and background noise. In order to combating this hostile PLC environment, a proprietary data encoder is recommended in the physical layer of the IEEE standard for broadband over power line networks. Accordingly, we design an intelligent data decoder combining deep neural network (DNN) and domain knowledge in decoding algorithms, able to learn and adapt the environment of PLC channel until achieving the optimal performance. The simulation results confirm the high-performance and low-complexity of the proposed decoder.

Author Keywords: power line communication (PLC), deep neural network (DNN), channel modeling, IEEE standard, intelligent data decoder

articleTitle: Research on Temperature Control System of Desktop 3D Printer Based on Fuzzy Adaptive
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In the printing process of desktop 3D printer, the printing consumables is to be heated and melted, and the layers of the extrusion layer are stacked. The heating temperature control system has the characteristics of nonlinearity, large inertia and large hysteresis, which it is some disadvantages for making the heating process take more time and inaccurating temperature control. Aiming at the above problems, a fuzzy adaptive desktop 3D printer temperature control strategy is proposed in this paper. The ARM LPC1768 high-performance microcontroller is combined with the fuzzy adaptive feature to implement temperature control fastly and precisly, and the temperature simulation model of the control system is established by Matlab/Simulink. The experimental results show that the fuzzy adaptive PID controller has the advantages of small overshoot, good temperature tracking performance, fast dynamic response and high reliability compared with the conventional PID control method. It is optimal for the temperature control of the desktop 3D printer.

Author Keywords: Desktop3Dprinter, Fuzzy adaptive, PID, Temperature control, ARM LPC1768

articleTitle: Hash Algorithm Optimization for Long-Span Digital Currency Transactions Based on Multi-Constraint Optimization
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Block chain technology and satellite integration to achieve wide-area security transactions has become a hot topic in the field of information security. It will face two major problems: the real-time transmission of large-span digital currency and the credibility of digital currency transmission under complex interference. In order to solve the above problems, this paper proposes a multi-constrained optimization-based hashing algorithm for long-span digital currency transactions. By analyzing satellite communication means and one-way hashing operation, the relationship between time delays under long-span digital currency transmission is obtained. By optimizing the hashing operation of constraints, the algorithm is improved largely. The adaptive ability of bit error rate (BER) and the construction of digital token based on multi-constraint enhanced hash algorithm provide a reliable authentication benchmark for digital currency transactions, design a large-span digital currency transaction process, and effectively suppress the information leakage caused by interference in the transmission process. The simulation results show that the performance of the proposed algorithm is greatly improved in security and complexity.

Author Keywords: block chain, satellite, hash algorithm, convex optimization

articleTitle: Application of the Double-Speed Method in the Integrity Inspection of Transmission Tower Pile Foundations
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Integrity inspection of pile foundations is very important to evaluate the service life of transmission tower. In this study, the double-speed method is employed to resolve the up-traveling wave. Based on the characteristics of the up-traveling wave, the integrity of the pile foundations of the transmission tower can be evaluated. A series of field tests are carried out to verify the accuracy of the proposed method.

Author Keywords: low strain method, transmission tower pile foundation, double-speed method

articleTitle: Comprehensive Energy flow Optimization Model Based on Energy Consumption Structure
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Under the bottleneck situation of traditional energy development, we should make full use of sustainable new energy supply and social consumption. The new energy system is composed of many types of independent power generation systems. The efficiency, quality and time cycle of energy conversion sources are different, which leads to different energy consumption pricing. Customers' consumption behavior will consider their demand and market price to use energy reasonably, which also causes the trend change of power grid energy trend. This paper focuses on the analysis of energy consumption structure model under the new situation, so as to guide and judge the development trend of power trend. This paper analyzes the structural factors of energy consumption that can affect the change of energy flow, extracts the important influencing factors. As the limiting conditions in the optimization model, uses the fast decomposition power flow analysis algorithm to build a comprehensive energy model. Provides more accurate decision-making for energy development and distribution through online calculation of real-time data.

Author Keywords: energy, consumption, trend, model

articleTitle: End-to-End Feature Learning for Multi-label Image Retrieval
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Hashing code similarity search is an effective method for large-scale image retrieval, since it provides fast search calculating and memory operating. In image retrieval, hash code based on deep convolutional networks can learn accurate image semantic information and compact hash code simultaneously. The existing methods generally extract the overall features of the image and generate corresponding hash codes. When the image contains multiple targets, this method may be suboptimal for describing the image, thus, limiting the accuracy of multi-label images. This paper focuses on the use of deep convolutional hash coding for multi-label image problems. In order to solve this problem, the authors propose a deep convolutional neural network structure suitable for multi-label image feature extraction. This network can also be used for end-to-end feature learning and further improve image retrieval accuracy. In this method, each target in the image is represented by a hash code and extensively evaluated across multiple data sets, making substantial improvement over the most advanced supervised and unsupervised hashing methods.

Author Keywords: component, Semantic Hashing, Large-scale image retrieval, multi-label image, Deep Learning

articleTitle: A Noise-Invariant Sparse Coding Model for Binary Input
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: A sparse distributed coding model that is consistent with the basic properties of the primary visual cortex is introduced. The binary input can be sparsely represented after a learning stage. The results of the sparse distributed coding have only a few nonzero coefficients to represent the input. In addition, it can also get the relative noise-robust representation. Firstly, a set of basic binary images or basic vectors can be found from the training data. Secondly, any binary input with the same dimension can be described as a linear combination of the basic vectors. According to the experimental results, the proposed coding model not only.

Author Keywords: Distributed, Sparse coding, Noise-invariant

articleTitle: Simulation of 5G Secondary Synchronization Signal Detection
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In the mobile communication, the cell search is used to implement time synchronization and frequency synchronization between the user and the cell, and acquire the physical cell identification number. A new synchronization signal structure is defined in the 5G communication system to complete the cell search, wherein the secondary synchronization signal is greatly changed, and the cell group ID in the physical cell identifier can be obtained by the effective secondary synchronization signal sequence detection. This paper focuses on the secondary synchronization signal detection process, and proposes to use the gold sequence characteristics of the secondary synchronization signal to simplify the operation process of obtaining the cell group ID in the physical layer cell identifier. The simulation results show that the proposed improved secondary synchronization signal detection algorithm can reduce the complexity of the cell group ID in the physical cell identifier detection while ensuring the correct rate.

Author Keywords: secondary synchronization signal, cell group ID in the physical cell, synchronization

articleTitle: Study of How to Obtain Control Flow Invariant
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: The traditional control flow integrity usually takes dynamic control transfer as the measurement object. And it means that the attacker can subvert software by modifying the obvious victim. To overcome it, a novel concept, called as control flow invariant, is presented in this paper. Control structure invariant is a certain law followed by software run. Not limited to dynamic control transfer, control structure invariant have more forms, thus supporting more types of control flow integrity measure. In order to find more control structure invariant, we proposes to use hardware to capture the trace information of software running, and analyze it to mine the control structure invariant. We give a case study that a system on Intel PMC is introduced to show the reasonableness of our solution.

Author Keywords: control flow, control flow invariant, dynamic control transfer, PMC, BTS

articleTitle: The Implementation of Spread Spectrum and Despreading in CD-RFID System
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In an RFID system, when multiple tags simultaneously send their ID data to the reader, a tag conflict will occur between them, causing the reader to fail to recognize the tag information properly. Multi-label conflicts can reduce the recognition efficiency of RFID systems. Reasonable anti-collision algorithms have become a hot issue in RFID technology. The application of CDMA technology to the RFID system proposed in this paper to achieve multi-channel communication can improve the reading efficiency and alleviate the conflict of labels. It can also solve the problem that multiple readers interfere with each other in a dense environment. Its advantages are mainly due to the simultaneous transmission of information by multiple channels brought by orthogonal sequences. Spreading and despreading of orthogonal spread spectrum is the key to digital system design. This paper mainly explains the way to implement this part, the process of despreading using the correlation algorithm of orthogonal sequence, and the methods to find the synchronization information of EPC code in the despreading process.

Author Keywords: CD-RFID, Multichannels, Correlation, Despreading

articleTitle: Application of BP Neural Network in Fire Risk Assessment of Comprehensive Shopping Mall
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: According to the influencing factors of fire occurrence in comprehensive shopping malls, a fire risk assessment index system is established by analytic hierarchy process (AHP) in consideration of flame retardant properties and other parameters. Then data of eight samples were obtained by the fire risk assessment index system and were input to BP neural network for training. Then, the trained BP model is applied to Jijia Shopping Center to evaluate its fire risk.

Author Keywords: Comprehensive Shopping Mall, BP Neural Network, Analytic Hierarchy Process, Fire Risk Assessment

articleTitle: P-L Band Digital T/R Module for Intelligence Radar
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In this paper, an active mixing P-L Band 4 channels digital T/R module is introduced. Four independent RF and digital TR channels are integrated. three-dimensional layout, standardization and modularization design are adopted. The power supply is 40 V, signal control and data transmission go through optical fiber. Good measured results are obtained.

Author Keywords: P-L band, digital T/R module, RF direct sampling, arbitrary signal generation

articleTitle: Modeling and Simulation of a New Ternary Lithium Battery Based on the 2th-Order Equivalent Circuit Model
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Power lithium battery modeling is the foundation of power battery research. To establish and select appropriate and accrrate battery model are vital during the development of BMS, Based on the analysis of the modeling method of a new ternary Lithiumion power battery, a 2th-order RC model is established. Then, the genetic algorithm is utilized to identify the circuit parameters through constant current pulse experiment. The simulation results show that the proposed RC model is effective, which can be used to estimate SOC.

Author Keywords: ternary lithium battery, BMS, the 2th order RC model, genetic algorithm, SOC

articleTitle: Source Routing Protocol Based on Bayesian Network for Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Multi-path routing is always the focus in wireless sensor networks. Either energy efficiency or QoS is taken into account in the existing multi-path routing, which makes the protocol not realize in both requirements. In this paper, the paths selection approach based on Bayesian network are introduced into the multi-path routing establishment, while two phase path selection mechanism according to Path ID and Path Ability respectively, are applied into the protocol. The simulation shows that BNSR is better than the other protocols on longivity and transmission delay.

Author Keywords: Wireless Sensor Networks, Multi-path, Bayesian network, Routing

articleTitle: An Adaptive Lockstep Synchronization Method for Scene Collaborative Editing of 3D Geometry
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: The collaborative and interactive scene editing in 3D geometry is an efficient method for field group work, but there are relatively few studies in this area at present. It is known that the existing methods for collaborative interaction editing are lockstep synchronization methods, which can solve the problem of multi-node synchronization editing. However, the existing lockstep synchronization method uses a fixed synchronization interval. When the network environment is not stable or the network of each node is different, the adaptability is poor. In order to realize the collaborative and interactive editing scene in 3D geometry, this paper presents a method of adaptive lockstep synchronization. Compared with the existing lockstep synchronization method, this method uses the adaptive synchronization interval instead of the fixed synchronization interval, thus resolving the drawbacks of the fixed synchronization interval lockstep synchronization method. The experimental results show that this method can realize the collaborative and interactive scene editing in 3D geometry under different network environments.

Author Keywords: collaborative and interactive editing, 3D geometry, lockstep synchronization, network environment, adaptive lockstep synchronization

articleTitle: A Collaborative-Filtering Recommendation Based on the Trust Network
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Many recommendation algorithms are proposed for the internet business system. However, many researches are focus on the model of users, items and their relation-ships. Recently, some studies proposed to use the trust relationships among users to optimize the accuracy of recommendation. But many studies recently did not consider the indirect trust relation between users. In our manuscript, we proposed an hybrid approach to mine the indirect and direct trust relation between any two users in the data set. Based on experiments used the real world public data set, our algorithm outperforms the other state-of-the-art approaches recently in the accuracy.

Author Keywords: recommendation, collaborative-filtering, trust network

articleTitle: Study on the Selections of Primary Variables in K-Values-Based Compositional Model
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: K-values-based compositional model has two selections of primary variables: the natural variable selection and the overall quantities variable selection. In this paper, we compare the differences of the two selections and the effects on computational accuracy and efficiency. A CO2 flooding numerical simulations shows that the accuracy of the two primary variable selections is the same, but the K-values-based compositional model with natural variable selection is more efficient and more stable than K-values-based compositional model with overall quantities variable selection.

Author Keywords: compositional model, computational efficiency natural variable, overall quantities variable

articleTitle: A Model Library Method of Android Malware Detection for Population
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that the recognizer generated by a single algorithm has differences in the identifing malware amang all population applications, this paper proposes a method of Android malware detection model library for population. Firstly, the python program crawls the application file and extracts the application permission set. Then, uses the Sequential Minmal Optimization algorithm to classify the set. Next, uses the trained constraint model algorithm to find the corresponding population recognizer pool in the model library by using the population attributes. Finally, uses the permission feature matrix as the input to run the classifier to get results. Each pool is made up of three algorithm. Experimental results show that this method is feasible and effective, and it can make the application of each population reach a better recognition rate.

Author Keywords: android, malware detection, model library, population, smo

articleTitle: Grayscale Feature Based Multi-Target Tracking Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of multi-target tracking accuracy decreasing and target SNR unknown in clutter environment, a multi-target tracking algorithm based on target grayscale feature is proposed. In this algorithm, the grayscale likelihood function based on SNR estimation and the grayscale likelihood function based on SNR prior information are constructed by using historical measurement information. When the tracking algorithm updates the target state, the grayscale likelihood function is introduced into the original likelihood function, and the grayscale likelihood function is used to increase the discrimination between the target and the clutter, so as to filter out more clutter and improve the tracking accuracy. Simulation results show that the algorithm can achieve better tracking effect in clutter environment, and has higher tracking accuracy and stability than the traditional algorithm.

Author Keywords: Grayscale feature, Grayscale likelihood function, Signal to noise ratio, Multi-target tracking.

articleTitle: A Cluster-Based Adaptive Routing Algorithm for Underwater Acoustic Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Underwater acoustic sensor networks (UASNs) have attracted much attention in both the academic and industrial fields. Routing design of a UASN is an important part of the research, yet routing algorithms with low energy consumption and high data delivery ratios are not established completely. This paper proposed the Cluster-Based Adaptive Routing Algorithm (CBAR) to fulfill the demands of large-scale underwater sensor networks. It optimized the network architecture by introducing the concept of a cluster in cellular wireless communication. Inspired by Focus Beam Routing and Hop-By-Hop Dynamic Addressing Routing protocol, the CBAR algorithm is designed to achieve better performance in large-scale UASNs. In CBAR, the format of transmitting data packets is simplified to suit the clustered network architecture and two adaptive methods are included: dynamic routing updates to adapt to the characteristics of the underwater environment, and power control to reduce energy consumption in the routing process. The result of simulation shows that the CBAR performs better than Focus Beam Routing and Distributed Underwater Clustering Scheme in terms of energy consumption and data delivery ratio, because CBAR can significantly reduce the energy consumption of the network and improve the life cycle of nodes with an optimal data delivery ratio.

Author Keywords: underwater sensor network, acoustic signal, dynamic routing algorithm, cluster, adaptive methods, low energy consumption

articleTitle: Study on Forecasting Soybean Production: An Application of ARIMA Model
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: This paper applies econometric modeling (Univariate Auto-Regressive Integrated Average Model) in forecasting soybean yield in Zambia. The time-series data for soybean yield analysis ranges from 1973 to 2016, collected from the FAO statistics and deliberated on the selected reliant model. In this analysis we employ a two-step Box-Jenkins method introduced by the statisticians George Box and Gwilym Jenkins. The sole purpose is to find the best fit of a time series model to preceding values of Soybean output. Additionally, in assessing the best fit of our model, we used Auto-Correlation, Partial Auto-Correlation, Regulated Bayesian Information Criterion, Dickey-Fuller test statistic, Ljung-Box-Pierce Q statistics as well as the projected residuals. Thus, using the ARIMA (p, d, q) model, the extrapolated statistics exposed that ARIMA (2, 2, 1) was the best model for forecasting soybean output. The results illustrate a cumulative trend in production with the projected value of 6611.7hg/ha in 2026. Thus, based on the selected model, it can be anticipated that in Zambia soybean output in 2020 would increase to 23430.3 hg/ha in comparison to 19624 hg/ha in 2016. Further, the study estimates a stable growth in the soybean yield in impending farming seasons.

Author Keywords: Forecasting, Soybean, Yield, Bayesian Information Criterion, Partial Auto-Correlation, Moving Average, Zambia

articleTitle: SOUA: Towards Intelligent Recommendation for Applying for Overseas Universities
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In China, to pursue a master's degree in foreign countries is becoming an increasingly popular choice for undergraduate students. However, predicting the results of university applications is mostly done by applying empirical rules and referring to previous admission cases similar to the applicant's conditions, which is unreliable. In this paper, we propose an intelligent recommendation method, called SOUA, to make recommendations for students who apply for the admissions of overseas universities to study abroad. Our method is proposed based on a dataset obtained by us, which is about Chinese undergraduate students' applying for master's degrees in computer science-related majors of American universities. We apply data mining techniques on this dataset. A new data augmentation method named ILGA is proposed to expand the size of the training set. In the experiments, machine learning models such as LR, KNN, DT, SVM, RF, GBDT and MLP are investigated using this dataset. The experimental results show that RF achieving a weighed f1-score of 71.2% on the test set outperforms other considered machine learning models. And RF produces the optimal university recommendation accuracy of 80.9%.

Author Keywords: higher education abroad, data mining, LR, KNN, SVM, RF, DT, GBDT

articleTitle: Progressive Face Dynamic Morphing
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: This work proposes a novel progressive face dynamic morphing approach, where facial structure is well preserved during the morphing process. To this end, we introduce a deep structure aligned model, by which we can achieve continuous alignment between source image and target image with high quality facial structure preservation. Also, a novel semi-supervised 3D expression animation approach is invoked for motion preservation in resulted sequence. Extensive experiments on both MMI facial expression dataset and CK AU-Coded expression dataset %wo common expression datasets demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of our model for face dynamic morphing.

Author Keywords: face dynamic morphing, structure alignment, 3D face reconstruction

articleTitle: TrORF: Building Trading Areas Around Organizations Based on Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Nowadays, making investments in trading areas around organizations is becoming increasingly pervasive since more and more organizations (e.g. universities) have been relocated in suburban-districts far from downtown. It generally requires a fairly long time for investors to make decisions and establish mature trading areas around organizations. Existing researches that focus on optimal location selection ignore the latent relationship between organizations and their surrounding business types. Therefore, this paper proposes a machine-learning based methodology of determining business types and trading areas, named TrORF, to help investors select business types and build trading areas around organizations. We implement our approach and evaluate it by using 13 real-world universities as our case studies. We compare the business type recommendation accuracy of the 13 real-world universities between our method and the other four existing methods. The experiment results indicate that our approach has strong ability to build the suitable business types around each university's trading area since its average recommendation accuracy is 98.23%, and it improves on other approaches by at least 13%.

Author Keywords: Machine Learning, Data Mining, Trading Area Building, Business Types Determination

articleTitle: Evaluation of the Influences of Hyper-Parameters and L2-Norm Regularization on ANN Model for MNIST Recognition
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Artificial neural networks (ANNs) have achieved the state-of-the-art performance in many tasks. Although ANNs do not require manually engineered features, there are lots of hyper-parameters to be optimized. The choices of hyper-parameters significantly impact the performance of the model. A number of methods like manual, grid, random search, and Bayesian optimization using Gaussian Processes (GPs) have been proposed to do the optimization. However, the work of exploring the individual effects of each parameter is rarely conducted. In this paper, we highlight on the effects of each individual hyper-parameter (involving the learning rate, batch size, the regularization item, and the number of iterations) on the model accuracy. We firstly construct a performance evaluation architecture that is based on method of normalized scoring to quantify the model performance. Then we establish an ANN for MNIST recognition and classification task to validate the proposed performance evaluation architecture. The experimental results show that a small learning rate and a small batch size not only affect the model's convergence speed but also make the model difficult to converge. The L2-norm regularization is critical for the overfitting elimination. Such an evaluation architecture can also be promoted to other similar related research areas.

Author Keywords: Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs), Control Variates Method, Grid Search, Hyper-Parameters, L2-norm Regularization, Normalized Scoring

articleTitle: PointerLock: Protecting Function Pointers with Access Control on Page
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Since function pointers are closely related to software control flow and they are writable, attackers often take function pointers as the targets. To protect the function pointers, we propose a novel solution called PointerLock. To avoid being tampered with by the attacker, PointerLock restricts the writing operation on the function pointers with the support of access control on the page. PointerLock centralizes the application's function pointers to a few pages, and these pages are only readable by default. Only when the application want to modify the pointer, PointerLock makes the page writable where the function pointer is located in. This reduces the time window of attacking the function pointer. To prevent an attacker from tampering with other function pointers on the same page as function pointers, PointerLock performs the necessary checks on the page before they are used again. The prototype system of PointerLock was built in Fedora 21 with a 3.17.6 kernel. Two system calls are implemented in kernel space, and six interfaces are developed for users in the form of dynamic link libraries in user space. The tests show that PointerLock is capable of preventing the attacker from tampering with the function pointers, and it does not introduced an overheavy performance.

Author Keywords: function pointer, page, access control

articleTitle: The Nonlinear Characteristics of Pig Price Fluctuation in China
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In recent years, due to the combined influence of various factors such as the African plague, China's pork prices have fluctuated frequently. Based on the data of pig price in China from January 2000 to April 2019, this paper uses the three-stage Markov intercept and variance transfer second-order autoregressive (MSIH(3)-AR(2)) model for China. The non-linear effects of pig prices were analyzed in depth. The results show that: (1) China's pig price fluctuations show non-linear fluctuation characteristics, and the spatial transmission of pig market price has obvious nonlinear characteristics. (2) The MSIH(3)-AR(2) model fits well the changes in the price of pigs in China. China's pork prices can be divided into three district systems: "price decline", "price growth" and "price rapid rise". (3) In different districts, China's pig price fluctuations have different levels of volatility, transition probability and duration. Finally, on the basis of summarizing the results, the corresponding policy opinions on stabilizing the price fluctuation of pork in China are given.

Index Terms: Porcine Reproductive And Respiratory Syndrome Virus
Author Keywords: component, Pig price, fluctuation, MSVAR model, district system conversion

articleTitle: Trusted Runtime Environment Building Technology for Mobile Terminals
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: This paper aims to study the basic theory of the "trusted foundation" of mobile intelligent terminals and build a trusted basic protection scheme that can be used for mobile application protection. Firstly, the ARM hardware structure of Android smartphone is used to study the security architecture of ARM terminal based on trusted technology, and realize the trusted software architecture through Android, analyze the functions at all levels; prove the credibility of Android mobile application APP security startup process, and the specification classifies the proposed trusted structure securely. Secondly, based on the machine code-based integrity measurement in the dynamic credibility of mobile applications, a credible measurement mechanism based on application behavior is studied. The current mobile platform operating environment is based on the integrity of the static integrity measurement mechanism extended to the credibility of the dynamic behavior of the mobile application runtime, combined with the APP using the access control mechanism, by evaluating the execution order access of the APP and related resources, thereby judging whether the application is trusted to build a dynamic and trusted operating environment. Thirdly, by studying the mobile Internet application and the remote authentication technology in trusted computing, the evidence of providing the authentication server with its legitimacy and the credibility of the terminal platform is realized, and the "trustworthiness" of the intelligent terminal is effectively guaranteed.

Author Keywords: trusted foundation, trust, runtime, terminal, authentication

articleTitle: A Novel Spatial-Temporal Fusion Framework Based on Object Trajectories
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: With the development of information technology, the traces of residents could be caught by sensors all over the city, from which to identify specific people such as suspects, has become the focus of public security departments in recent years. Although there are some advantages of the mass of Spatio-temporal records, the activity records contain both temporal and spatial context is high-order and sparse. Therefore, it is difficult to identify users, especially for those small groups of individuals. In this paper, we propose a framework to identify users by fuzzed Spatio-temporal traces, in which we first extract the features from several perspectives and generate the TSGH (Time-slice Geohash) model and STPS (Spatio-temporal Proportion and Similarity) model. All these features are combined with classical classification models to distinguish users. We set up a real-life dataset and evaluate performance effectiveness with precision and recall measures. The final results show that the fuzzy operations could describe the characteristic of traces better and improve the prediction performance.

Author Keywords: Spatio-temporal records, user identification, feature extraction

articleTitle: A Performance Impovement Method for Optimal Operation of A Domestic Building Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Microgrid technology brings opportunities to improve the building energy efficiency. While the uncertainties of renewable power sources and the variability of occupants' energy demand brings challenges to the stable and secure operation of the utility grid. Considering the optimal operation of building microgrid under both supply and demand sides' uncertainties, the following major contributions are made in this paper. First, the building microgrid operation problem is formulated as a Markov decision process (MDP) with the objective minimizing the electricity cost. Second, a policy improvement (PI) method with stochastic simulation is proposed to accelerate the on-line solving process. Third, numerical tests are made on a typical domestic building microgrid and PI method is applied to a rule-based control policy and a greedy control policy. Numerical results demonstrate their performance improvement and the effectiveness of the proposed method is validated.

Author Keywords: microgrid, renewable power, Markov decision process, policy improvement

articleTitle: Semantic Equivalent Relation Phrase Extraction for RDF Predicates
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Relation phrase mapping can fill the gap between the relation phrase and the RDF predicates. It can be widely used in question/answer system to help the general users ask questions in natural language over an RDF knowledge base. Relation phrase mapping is one of the most important steps to mine the semantic meaning of natural language questions. Instance extraction has been well studied by some literal work whereas the semantic meaning for relation phrase has the same importance. The gAnswer system has conducted a paraphrase dictionary to fill the gap between the relation phrase and the RDF predicates. However, the precision of the paraphrase dictionary is unsatisfactory for natural language question answer. In this paper, we adopt the structure of gAnswer and present a method to build a more accurate paraphrase dictionary using vector space model. The result confirms that our method can generate a large number of relation phrase and improve the precision at the same time.

Author Keywords: Relation phase, RDF, Predicate.

articleTitle: Analysis of a New Fractional Variational Model for Image Noise Removal
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In this paper, a new variational model based on fractional-order partial differential is proposed for removing noise. We analyse the mathematical property of the proposed model, and prove our model exists the unique weak solution on fractional-order bounded variation space. Numerical analysis and Matlab simulation are also implemented, the experimental results show that the proposed model doesn't only have better denoising ability than some existing integer-order and fractional-order variational models, but also preserved better the textural details and eliminated obviously the staircase effect.

Author Keywords: Fractional-order derivative, space of functions of fractional bounded variation, calculus of variation, image denoising, existence, uniqueness

articleTitle: Low Complexity Network Coding Aware Routing for Wireless Multi-hop Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Network coding is a technology with great potentiality in improving wireless multi-hop network throughput. And some routings combined with network coding have been proposed for wireless multi-hop network. In the routings combined with network coding, network coding condition is used to find network coding opportunities, which is very important to the performance improving of routings combined with network coding. However, the network coding conditions defined by existing routings combined with network coding unilaterally focus on the growth of network coding opportunities, which results in the increasing of cost and delay in routing discovery. Moreover, the more flows participating network coding, the higher probability of decoding failure, which degrade the network coding gain. In this paper, low complexity network coding condition (LCNC) is proposed. LCNC only detects two-flows network coding opportunity, and ensures the destination make successful decoding. In addition, the actual network coding gain is designed through analysis of link quality. Network coding opportunity will be ignored in case the actual network coding gain is negative. Based on LCNC, a low complexity network coding aware routing (LNCR) is designed aiming wireless multi-hop network. Simulation results demonstrate that LNCR obtain a balance between network coding gain and routing discovery cost, and can obtain higher network throughput when the network load is high compared with the classical network coding aware routings.

Author Keywords: network coding, routing, wireless multi-hop network, low complexity, network coding condition

articleTitle: Fault Localization for Power Line Communications with Topology Inference
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Power line communications (PLC) is one of the communication methods which have been deployed and attracted considerable attention on supporting smart grid applications. Furthermore, link failures will have a great impact on the normal operation of PLC network and the causes of link failures are diverse. Therefore, rapid fault location is extremely important for PLC. Fault localization generally requires complete knowledge of the network topology which is usually unknown and needs to be learned by topology inference algorithms. However, it is difficult for routers to collect complete topology information for topology inference. We propose an algorithm based on partial information for topology inference to help the PLC to detect and locate faults normally. The inference algorithm first builds a virtual topology, overestimates the number of network components, and then repeatedly merges the links in this topology to infer the structure of the real network. We conducted simulations and compared our algorithm with the most advanced inference algorithms. The results show that compared with other methods, the topology structure of our inference algorithm significantly improves the performance of the fault location.

Author Keywords: component, Power line communications, fault localization, topology inference

articleTitle: Inferring Structural Characteristics of Social Network for Smart Grid Adoption and Diffusion
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: The smart grid is developing in the direction of two-way interaction. As an important platform for two-way interaction between the user side and the power system, the social network plays an important role in the development of the smart grid. The structural parameters of the social network include the total number of users and the network density. The network density is reflected by the number of neighbor nodes of the network node and the strength of the connection. Determining the total number of users in the network is beneficial to the smart grid for power allocation. Power system load peaks, insufficient power supply, etc. Deter-mining network density helps speed up the popularization and promotion of smart grid technology and helps to understand the social influence of users in social networks. Offline social network topologies are usually selected by interviewees and then asked to list their neighbors. This paper proposes an inference technique based on so-called “fixed choice” surveys, which requires the interviewee to enumerate all the strong ties and a fixed number of weak ties(e.g.,two or ten). Then use the method of moments to infer the total number of users and the network density of the social network. Experiments using simulated data show that the proposed inference algor-ithm performs well in various network topo-logies and measurement scenarios, and the est-imates obtained are significantly more accu-rate than the estimates obtained directly using the coarse observation network.

Author Keywords: component:-network-sampling,-social-networks,-smart-grids,-statistical-inference

articleTitle: Inter-Flow and Intra-Flow Network Coding Aware Routing for Wireless Multi-hop Network
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Network coding possesses great potentiality in promoting wireless multi-hop network throughput performance. Network coding applied in routings includes intra-flow network coding and inter-flow network coding. The aim of intra-flow network coding is to promote wireless transmissions reliability. For inter-flow network coding, its purpose is to reduce transmission number and rise network throughput. In this paper, an inter-flow and intra-flow network coding aware routing (RACR) is designed for wireless multi-hop network to make use of the benefits of both intra-flow and inter-flow network coding. RACR actively detects inter-flow coding opportunities on the basis of network coding condition in routing discovery in order to discover more coding opportunities. In addition, intra-flow network coding is exploited at source node of each flow to ensure correct inter-flow decoding and to avoid the dependence on the receiving of any specific packet. The simulation results on NS2 confirm that RACR can reduce transmissions times and rise the throughput of network.

Author Keywords: inter-flow, intra-flow, network coding, routing, wireless multi-hop network

articleTitle: Research on the Operational Concept Modeling, Measurement Method Based on JMT
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of modeling, deduction and measurement of operational concepts, a method of modeling and measurement of operational concepts based on Joint Mission Thread (JMT) and Activity-Based Method (ABM) is proposed. Combining the actual situation of our country and its own characteristics, according to the characteristics of ABM and JMT, the operational concepts are modeled. Through model deduction based on OPM (Object-Process Methodology), the function and logic of the operational concepts are tested. Combining with JMT, the operational concepts are decomposed into indicators to realize the measurability of the operational concepts. This method can provide reference for the normative description, modeling, testing and index decomposition of operational concepts.

Author Keywords: Joint Mission Thread, Activity-Based Methodology, operational concept modeling, measurement
